// A chosen section whose subjects look like another year's: either its name says one year and its saved year another,
// or most of its subjects are the same as those of sections that belong to a different year.
export function yearWarningsFor(chosen, rawSections, year) {
  const names = sec => new Set((sec.subjects || []).map(x => String(x.name || "").trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean));
  const out = [];
  chosen.forEach(c => {
    const raw = rawSections.find(r => r.id === c.id) || {};
    const fromName = yearFromName(raw.name);
    if (raw.year && fromName && raw.year !== fromName) {
      out.push({ id: c.id, text: c.name + " is saved as Year " + raw.year + ", but its name says Year " + fromName + ". If Year " + fromName + " is right, its subjects belong to that year, not this one." });
      return;
    }
    const mine = names(c);
    if (mine.size < 3) return;
    const share = o => { const t = names(o); let n = 0; mine.forEach(x => { if (t.has(x)) n++; }); return n / mine.size; };
    let best = { v: 0, name: "", yr: "" }, same = 0;
    rawSections.forEach(o => {
      if (o.id === c.id) return;
      const v = share(o);
      if (yearOfSection(o) === year) same = Math.max(same, v);
      else if (v > best.v) best = { v, name: o.name, yr: yearOfSection(o) };
    });
    if (best.v >= 0.6 && best.v > same) out.push({ id: c.id, text: c.name + " is saved as Year " + year + ", but " + Math.round(best.v * 100) + "% of its subjects are the same as " + best.name + (best.yr ? " (Year " + best.yr + ")" : "") + ". Its year may be wrong." });
  });
  return out;
}
function loadDraft(phone, year) {
  try { const s = localStorage.getItem(draftKey(phone, year)); if (s) return { ...defaultAnswers(), ...JSON.parse(s), sectionIds: [] }; } catch (e) { /* no saved draft */ }
  return defaultAnswers();
}

// A version's section timetable as a small grid: days down, periods across.
function SectionGrid({ spec, blocks, sectionId, colourOf }) {
  const slots = spec.timings.slots;
  const mine = blocks.filter(b => b.sectionId === sectionId);
  const days = spec.D;
  return (
    <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
      <table style={{ borderCollapse: "separate", borderSpacing: 3, minWidth: 640 }}>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th />
            {slots.map((s, i) => <th key={i} style={{ fontSize: 10.5, color: P.gray, fontWeight: 700, padding: "2px 4px", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{s.brk ? (s.label || "Break") : "P" + s.n}<div style={{ fontWeight: 400, fontFamily: MONO }}>{fmtRange(s.start, s.end)}</div></th>)}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {Array.from({ length: days }, (_, d) => (
            <tr key={d}>
              <td style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, paddingRight: 8 }}>{DAY_ABBR[d]}</td>
              {(() => {
                const cells = [];
                let i = 0;
                while (i < slots.length) {
                  const s = slots[i];
                  if (s.brk) { cells.push(<td key={i} style={{ background: "#f6efdc", borderRadius: 5, width: 18 }} />); i++; continue; }
                  if (d === 5 && s.n > periodsOn(spec.a, 5)) { cells.push(<td key={i} style={{ background: "#f3f4f6", borderRadius: 5 }} />); i++; continue; }
                  const starts = mine.filter(b => b.day === d && b.start === s.start);
                  if (!starts.length) { cells.push(<td key={i} style={{ background: "#fafafa", border: "1px dashed " + P.border, borderRadius: 5, textAlign: "center", color: "#c3c9d0", fontSize: 12 }}>-</td>); i++; continue; }
                  const end = Math.max(...starts.map(b => b.end));
                  let j = i;
                  while (j + 1 < slots.length && slots[j + 1].end <= end) j++;
                  const [bg, fg] = colourOf(starts[0].token);
                  cells.push(
                    <td key={i} colSpan={j - i + 1} title={starts.map(b => b.token + " - " + (b.faculty.map(f => f.name).join(", ") || "no faculty")).join("\n")} style={{ background: "#" + bg, color: "#" + fg, borderRadius: 5, padding: "6px 8px", textAlign: "center", fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 74 }}>
                      {starts.map(b => <div key={b.id}>{b.token}</div>)}
                    </td>
                  );
                  i = j + 1;
                }
                return cells;
              })()}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function VersionCard({ spec, v, n, colourOf, onPublish, onDownload, onEdit, onUndoEdits }) {
  const [sec, setSec] = useState(spec.sections[0] ? spec.sections[0].id : "");
  const load = useMemo(() => computeWorkload(v.blocks).filter(w => !w.external), [v]);
  const most = load.slice().sort((x, y) => y.teaching - x.teaching)[0];
  const least = load.slice().sort((x, y) => x.teaching - y.teaching)[0];
  return (
    <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: "16px 18px" }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 17 }}>Version {n} <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 13, color: P.gray }}>Â· sheets TT-{n} and Ind-{n}</span></div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={onDownload}>Download Excel (TT-{n}, Ind-{n})</Btn>
          <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={onEdit}>Minor changes</Btn>
          <Btn small onClick={onPublish}>Use and publish this version</Btn>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.gray }}>{v.edited ? <b style={{ color: P.blue }}>Changed by you Â· </b> : null}{v.blocks.length} classes Â· no overlaps{most ? " Â· heaviest load " + most.name + " (" + most.teaching + " periods)" : ""}{least && least !== most ? ", lightest " + least.name + " (" + least.teaching + ")" : ""}</div>
      </div>
      {v.edited && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 8 }}><span style={{ color: P.gray }}>This version has your minor changes. </span><button onClick={onUndoEdits} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: P.blue, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0, fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 13 }}>Go back to the version as designed</button></div>}
      {v.relaxed.length > 0 ? (
        <details style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <summary style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.amber, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>{v.relaxed.length} preference{v.relaxed.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} could not be kept</summary>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: P.gray, padding: "6px 0 0 14px" }}>{v.relaxed.map((t, i) => <div key={i}>â€¢ {t}</div>)}</div>
        </details>
      ) : <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.green, marginBottom: 10 }}>Every preference you gave is kept.</div>}
      <div style={{ display: spec.sections.length > 1 ? "flex" : "none", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 10 }}>
        {spec.sections.map(s => (
          <button key={s.id} onClick={() => setSec(s.id)} style={{ padding: "5px 12px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", border: "1.5px solid " + (sec === s.id ? P.blue : P.border), background: sec === s.id ? P.blue : "#fff", color: sec === s.id ? "#fff" : P.navy }}>{s.name}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <SectionGrid spec={spec} blocks={v.blocks} sectionId={sec} colourOf={colourOf} />
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function DesignScreen({ user, onBack }) {
  const [sections, setSections] = useState(null);
  const [people, setPeople] = useState(null);
  const [published, setPublished] = useState([]);
  const [year, setYear] = useState("III");
  const [a, setA] = useState(() => loadDraft(user.phone, "III"));
  const [editN, setEditN] = useState(0);        // the version being given minor changes
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [sets, setSets] = useState([]);       // each: { versions, problems, attempts, completes }
  const [specUsed, setSpecUsed] = useState(null);
  const [showSet, setShowSet] = useState(0);
  const [confirmN, setConfirmN] = useState(0);   // version waiting for "Yes, publish"
  const [pubBusy, setPubBusy] = useState(false);
  const [pubMsg, setPubMsg] = useState({ ok: true, text: "" });
  const sigs = useRef([]);
  const seeAll = user.phone === MASTER_ADMIN_PHONE || user.role === "hod";

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = onSnapshot(collection(db, "sections"), snap => {
      const all = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })).filter(s => !s.deleted);
      setSections(seeAll ? all : all.filter(s => s.adminPhone === user.phone));
    });
    return unsub;
  }, [user.phone, seeAll]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    getDocs(collection(db, "users")).then(us => {
      if (!alive) return;
      const list = [];
      us.forEach(d => { const u = d.data(); if (u.status === "approved") list.push({ phone: d.id, name: u.name || d.id }); });
      setPeople(list.sort((x, y) => x.name.localeCompare(y.name)));
    });
    const unsubPub = onSnapshot(collection(db, "masterTimetables"), snap => { if (alive) setPublished(snap.docs.map(d => ({ year: d.id, ...d.data() }))); }, () => {});
    return () => { alive = false; unsubPub(); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { try { localStorage.setItem(draftKey(user.phone, year), JSON.stringify({ ...a, sectionIds: [] })); } catch (e) { /* storage off */ } }, [a, user.phone, year]);

  const ctx = useMemo(() => {
    const allSections = (sections || []).filter(s => yearOfSection(s) === year).map(s => ({
      id: s.id, name: s.name,
      subjects: (s.subjects || []).map(sub => ({
        name: sub.name, token: String(sub.short || sub.name || "").toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, " "),
        type: sub.type || guessType(sub.name), faculty: facultyListOf(sub),
      })),
    }));
    // one section at a time is the usual way; tick more to design them together
    const chosen = allSections.filter(s => (a.sectionIds || []).includes(s.id));
    const yearSections = chosen;
    const byName = new Map();
    yearSections.forEach(s => s.subjects.forEach(sub => {
      if (!byName.has(sub.name)) byName.set(sub.name, { name: sub.name, type: sub.type, sections: [] });
      byName.get(sub.name).sections.push({ id: s.id, name: s.name });
    }));
    return { yearSections, allSections, selectedIds: yearSections.map(s => s.id), subjects: Array.from(byName.values()), people: people || [], yearWarnings: yearWarningsFor(yearSections, sections || [], year) };
  }, [sections, people, year, a.sectionIds]);

  // every subject gets a starting number; nothing already typed is overwritten
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ctx.subjects.length) return;
    setA(prev => {
      let changed = false;
      const loads = { ...prev.loads };
      ctx.subjects.forEach(s => {
        if (!loads[s.name]) { loads[s.name] = s.type === "Theory" ? { periods: 4, block: 1 } : { periods: 3, block: Number(prev.labBlock) || 3 }; changed = true; }
      });
      return changed ? { ...prev, loads } : prev;
    });
  }, [ctx.subjects, a.loads]);

  const calc = useMemo(() => {
    const mine = new Set(ctx.selectedIds);
    const other = published.flatMap(p => (p.blocks || []).filter(b => p.year !== year || !mine.has(b.sectionId)).map(b => ({ ...b, source: "published", publishedYear: p.year, publishedBy: p.publishedByName || "" })));
    return buildSpec({ year, a, sections: ctx.yearSections, people: ctx.people, published: other });
  }, [year, a, ctx, published]);

  if (!sections || !people) return <Spinner />;

  const set = patch => setA(prev => {
    const next = { ...prev, ...patch };
    if (TIMING_KEYS.some(k => k in patch) && !("timingsConfirmed" in patch)) next.timingsConfirmed = false;
    return next;
  });
  const changeYear = y => { setYear(y); setA(loadDraft(user.phone, y)); setSets([]); setSpecUsed(null); sigs.current = []; };
  const startAgain = () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Start again from the beginning? Your answers and any versions designed on this screen are cleared. Nothing that is already published is changed.")) return;
    try { localStorage.removeItem(draftKey(user.phone, year)); } catch (e) { /* storage off */ }
    setA(defaultAnswers()); setSets([]); setSpecUsed(null); sigs.current = []; setStep(0); setConfirmN(0); setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: "" });
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  };
  const chooseSections = ids => { set({ sectionIds: ids }); setSets([]); setSpecUsed(null); sigs.current = []; setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: "" }); };

  const hasSubjects = ctx.yearSections.some(s => s.subjects.length > 0);
  const sid = STEPS[step].id;
  const canNext = sid === "year" ? ctx.yearSections.length > 0 && hasSubjects : true;
  const noSection = ctx.yearSections.length === 0;

  const built = calc;
  const errors = (noSection ? [{ level: "error", step: "year", text: "No section is chosen. Open the Year tab and tick the section you want to design." }] : []).concat(a.timingsConfirmed ? [] : [{ level: "error", step: "time", text: "The period timings haven't been checked yet. Open Days and periods, look at the timings, and tick â€œthese timings are correctâ€." }]).concat(built.problems.filter(p => p.level === "error"));
  const warns = built.problems.filter(p => p.level !== "error");
  const goTo = id => { const i = STEPS.findIndex(x => x.id === id); if (i >= 0) { setStep(i); window.scrollTo(0, 0); } };

  function design(more) {
    if (!built || !built.spec) return;
    setBusy(true); setEditN(0);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const res = designVersions(built.spec, ctx.people, { count: 3, skip: more ? sigs.current : [], timeMs: 9000 });
      res.versions.forEach(v => sigs.current.push(v.sig));
      setSpecUsed(built.spec);
      setSets(prev => (more ? [...prev, res] : [res]));
      setShowSet(more ? sets.length : 0);
      setBusy(false);
    }, 60);
  }

  async function publishVersion(n) {
    const v = sets[showSet].versions[n - 1];
    setPubBusy(true); setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: "" });
    try {
      const merged = mergeSections(published.find(p => p.year === year), v.blocks, sectionsOf(specUsed));
      await publishMaster({ year, blocks: merged.blocks, sections: merged.sections, user, fileName: "Designed in the portal (version " + n + ")" });
      setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: specUsed.sections.map(x => x.name).join(", ") + " published from Version " + n + " (" + v.blocks.length + " classes) in the Year " + year + " timetable. Faculty now see their classes in My Timetable." });
      setConfirmN(0);
    } catch (err) {
      setPubMsg({ ok: false, text: "Could not publish (" + err.message + "). Nothing was changed." });
    }
    setPubBusy(false);
  }

  const versionFile = n => "Timetable design - " + (specUsed.sections.length === 1 ? specUsed.sections[0].name : "Year " + year + " (" + specUsed.sections.length + " sections)").replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "") + " - Version " + n + ".xlsx";
  const changeVersion = (i, fn) => setSets(prev => prev.map((st, si) => (si === showSet ? { ...st, versions: st.versions.map((v, vi) => (vi === i ? fn(v) : v)) } : st)));
  const saveEdit = (i, blocks) => { changeVersion(i, v => ({ ...v, blocks, edited: true, orig: v.orig || v.blocks })); setEditN(0); setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: "Your minor changes to Version " + (i + 1) + " are saved. There are no overlaps. You can download or publish it." }); };
  const undoEdits = i => { if (window.confirm("Go back to Version " + (i + 1) + " as it was designed? Your minor changes to it are lost.")) changeVersion(i, v => ({ ...v, blocks: v.orig || v.blocks, edited: false, orig: undefined })); };
  const editOthers = () => {
    const used = new Set(specUsed.sections.map(x => x.id));
    return published.flatMap(pb => (pb.blocks || []).filter(b => pb.year !== year || !used.has(b.sectionId)).map(b => ({ ...b, source: "published", publishedYear: pb.year, publishedBy: pb.publishedByName || "" })));
  };
  const current = sets[showSet];
  const alreadyPublished = published.find(p => p.year === year);
  const colourOf = current && current.versions.length ? subjectColours(current.versions.flatMap(v => v.blocks)) : null;

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: "24px clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px) 80px", maxWidth: "min(1300px, 96vw)", margin: "0 auto", display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        <Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={onBack}>â† Back</Btn>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 20 }}>Design a timetable</div>
        <div style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }}><Btn small variant="outline" onClick={startAgain}>Start again</Btn></div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
          <button key={s.id} onClick={() => setStep(i)} style={{ padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: "inherit", cursor: "pointer", border: "1.5px solid " + (i === step ? P.blue : P.border), background: i === step ? P.blue : "#fff", color: i === step ? "#fff" : P.navy }}>{i + 1}. {s.title}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: "10px 22px 18px" }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 17, padding: "12px 0 0" }}>{STEPS[step].title}</div>
          {sid !== "year" && noSection && (
            <div style={{ padding: "26px 4px 14px" }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, marginBottom: 6 }}>Choose the section first</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: P.gray, marginBottom: 14, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>Nothing is chosen yet, so there are no subjects to show. Go to the Year tab, pick the year, and tick the section you want to design.</div>
              <Btn onClick={() => goTo("year")}>Go to the Year tab</Btn>
            </div>
          )}
          {sid === "year" && <StepYear ctx={ctx} year={year} setYear={changeYear} setSelected={chooseSections} published={published} />}
          {sid === "time" && !noSection && <StepTimings a={a} set={set} />}
          {sid === "subj" && !noSection && <StepSubjects a={a} set={set} ctx={ctx} calc={calc} />}
          {sid === "tog" && !noSection && <StepTogether a={a} set={set} ctx={ctx} />}
          {sid === "lim" && !noSection && <StepLimits a={a} set={set} />}
          {sid === "av" && !noSection && <StepAvailability a={a} set={set} ctx={ctx} />}
          {sid === "rev" && !noSection && (
            <>
              <Q title="Anything else I should know?" hint="Type it here. I can't act on free text, but it is kept with your answers for whoever reads them, and I'll tell you if I couldn't do something you asked for above.">
                <textarea value={a.notes} onChange={e => set({ notes: e.target.value })} rows={3} style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1.5px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 8, padding: "9px 12px", fontSize: 14, fontFamily: "inherit" }} />
              </Q>
              <Q title="Before I design">
                {errors.length === 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 14, color: P.green, fontWeight: 600 }}>Nothing stops the design. {built && built.spec ? built.spec.units.length + " classes to place across " + built.spec.sections.length + " section" + (built.spec.sections.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + "." : ""}</div>}
                {errors.length > 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: P.red, marginBottom: 6 }}>These need fixing before I can design. Each has a button that takes you to the right tab:</div>}
                {errors.map((p, i) => (
                  <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: P.red, background: P.redL, borderRadius: 8, padding: "10px 12px", margin: "6px 0", display: "flex", gap: 12, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                    <span style={{ flex: "1 1 420px", lineHeight: 1.55 }}>{p.text}</span>
                    {p.step && <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={() => goTo(p.step)}>Go to {(STEPS.find(x => x.id === p.step) || {}).title}</Btn>}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {warns.map((p, i) => <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.amber, padding: "3px 0" }}>âš  {p.text}</div>)}
              </Q>
              {built && built.spec && (
                <Q title="Weekly periods per section">
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                    {built.spec.sections.map(s => {
                      const need = built.spec.units.filter(u => u.sectionIds.includes(s.id)).reduce((t, u) => t + u.size, 0);
                      const have = built.spec.P.reduce((t, n) => t + n, 0);
                      return <span key={s.id} style={{ fontSize: 13, background: need > have ? P.redL : P.bg, border: "1px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 20, padding: "5px 12px" }}><b style={{ fontFamily: MONO }}>{s.name}</b> Â· {need} of {have} periods</span>;
                    })}
                  </div>
                </Q>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {sid === "year" && ctx.yearSections.length === 0 && ctx.allSections.length > 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.amber, textAlign: "right", marginTop: 10 }}>Tick the section you want to design to go on.</div>}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 10, paddingTop: 16, borderTop: "1px solid " + P.border, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Btn variant="outline" disabled={step === 0} onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)}>â† Back</Btn>
            {sid !== "rev"
              ? <Btn disabled={!canNext} onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>Next â†’</Btn>
              : <Btn disabled={busy || errors.length > 0 || !built || !built.spec} onClick={() => design(false)}>{busy ? "Designingâ€¦" : sets.length ? "Design again" : "Design the timetables"}</Btn>}
          </div>
        </Card>

      {busy && <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: 20 }}><Spinner /><div style={{ textAlign: "center", color: P.gray, fontSize: 14 }}>Designing clash-free timetablesâ€¦</div></Card>}

      {!busy && current && (
        <>
          {sets.length > 1 && (
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              {sets.map((s, i) => <button key={i} onClick={() => setShowSet(i)} style={{ padding: "6px 14px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", border: "1.5px solid " + (i === showSet ? P.blue : P.border), background: i === showSet ? P.blue : "#fff", color: i === showSet ? "#fff" : P.navy }}>Set {i + 1}</button>)}
            </div>
          )}
          {current.versions.length === 0 ? (
            <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: "16px 20px", borderColor: P.red }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, color: P.red, marginBottom: 6 }}>I couldn't make a timetable with these answers</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, marginBottom: 8, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>I tried {current.attempts} different arrangements. {sets.length > 1 ? "No new version was found this time: the earlier ones may be the only ones that fit." : "Here is what got in the way:"}</div>
              {current.problems.map((t, i) => <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 13.5, padding: "3px 0" }}>â€¢ {t}</div>)}
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.gray, marginTop: 10 }}>Go back and loosen one of these (a daily limit, a subject's periods, a faculty member's unavailable slots), then design again.</div>
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: "14px 18px", borderColor: P.green }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, color: P.green }}>{current.versions.length} clash-free version{current.versions.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} ready</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.gray, marginTop: 2 }}>Each version has its own Excel file with 2 sheets: TT (every section's timetable) and Ind (every faculty member's own). Use <b>Minor changes</b> on a version to adjust it on screen.{current.versions.length < 3 ? " Only " + current.versions.length + " genuinely different arrangement" + (current.versions.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " fit your rules." : ""}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                    <Btn variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => design(true)}>Redesign: another set</Btn>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Card>
              {pubMsg.text && <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: pubMsg.ok ? P.green : P.red, background: pubMsg.ok ? P.greenL : P.redL, borderRadius: 10, padding: "12px 16px", fontWeight: 600 }}>{pubMsg.text}</div>}
              {confirmN > 0 && (
                <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: "16px 20px", borderColor: P.blue }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, marginBottom: 6 }}>Publish Version {confirmN} as the Year {year} timetable?</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: 12 }}>
                    It has no overlaps. {specUsed.sections.map(x => x.name).join(", ")} ({current.versions[confirmN - 1].blocks.length} classes) will be saved in the Year {year} timetable.
                    {alreadyPublished && (() => {
                      const ids = new Set(specUsed.sections.map(x => x.id));
                      const replaced = (alreadyPublished.sections || []).filter(x => ids.has(x.id)).map(x => x.name);
                      const kept = (alreadyPublished.sections || []).filter(x => !ids.has(x.id)).map(x => x.name);
                      return <>
                        {replaced.length > 0 && <> <b style={{ color: P.amber }}>This replaces the published timetable of {replaced.join(", ")}.</b></>}
                        {kept.length > 0 && <> Other sections stay as they are: {kept.join(", ")}.</>}
                      </>;
                    })()}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>
                    <Btn onClick={() => publishVersion(confirmN)} disabled={pubBusy}>{pubBusy ? "Publishingâ€¦" : "Yes, publish"}</Btn>
                    <Btn variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfirmN(0)} disabled={pubBusy}>Cancel</Btn>
                  </div>
                </Card>
              )}
              {current.versions.map((v, i) => editN === i + 1
                ? <VersionEditor key={v.sig + ":edit"} spec={specUsed} n={i + 1} blocks={v.blocks} others={editOthers()} people={ctx.people} colourOf={colourOf} onSave={blocks => saveEdit(i, blocks)} onCancel={() => setEditN(0)} />
                : <VersionCard key={v.sig} spec={specUsed} v={v} n={i + 1} colourOf={colourOf}
                    onPublish={() => { setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: "" }); setConfirmN(i + 1); }}
                    onDownload={() => writeVersionWorkbook(specUsed, v, i + 1, versionFile(i + 1))}
                    onEdit={() => { setPubMsg({ ok: true, text: "" }); setEditN(i + 1); }}
                    onUndoEdits={() => undoEdits(i)} />)}
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.gray, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>Happy with one? Publish it. To change something first, press <b>Minor changes</b> on that version: edit it on screen, and every change is checked for overlaps before it is kept. You can also edit the downloaded Excel yourself and bring it back through <b>Upload a timetable</b>.</div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { buildSpec, designVersions } from "./generator";
import { defaultAnswers } from "./designModel";
import { sectionsOf } from "./designExport";
import { moveBlock, swapBlocks, changeFaculty, removeBlock, addBlock, checkEdit, loadWarnings, startOptions } from "../timetableUpload/editChecks";

function setup() {
  const people = [1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => ({ phone: "p" + i, name: "Dr " + i }));
  const mk = (id, name) => ({ id, name, subjects: ["T1", "T2", "T3"].map((n, i) => ({ name: n, token: n, type: "Theory", faculty: ["p" + (i + 1)] })) });
  const sections = [mk("s1", "III-A"), mk("s2", "III-B")];
  const a = defaultAnswers(); a.allowBlank = true;
  ["T1", "T2", "T3"].forEach(n => { a.loads[n] = { periods: 4, block: 1 }; });
  const { spec } = buildSpec({ year: "III", a, sections, people, published: [] });
  const res = designVersions(spec, people, { count: 1, seed: 11 });
  return { secs: sectionsOf(spec), blocks: res.versions[0].blocks.map(b => ({ ...b })) };
}

test("moving to a free place is allowed; onto the faculty's other class is refused", () => {
  const { secs, blocks } = setup();
  const s1 = secs.find(s => s.id === "s1");
  const b = blocks.find(x => x.sectionId === "s1" && x.token === "T1");
  const free = [];
  for (let d = 0; d < 6; d++) startOptions(b, s1.slots).forEach(o => { if (!blocks.some(x => x.sectionId === "s1" && x.day === d && x.start < o.end && o.start < x.end)) free.push([d, o.start]); });
  const ok = moveBlock(blocks, b.id, free[0][0], free[0][1], s1.slots);
  expect(ok.error).toBeUndefined();
  expect(typeof ok.text).toBe("string");

  const other = blocks.find(x => x.sectionId === "s2" && x.token === "T1");
  const clash = moveBlock(blocks, b.id, other.day, other.start, s1.slots);
  if (!clash.error) {
    const chk = checkEdit(clash.blocks, clash.editedIds, []);
    expect(chk.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(chk.problems.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  }
});

test("a section can't get two classes at once; swap, remove and add work", () => {
  const { secs, blocks } = setup();
  const s1 = secs.find(s => s.id === "s1");
  const a = blocks.find(x => x.sectionId === "s1" && x.token === "T1");
  const b = blocks.find(x => x.sectionId === "s1" && x.token === "T2");
  const mv = moveBlock(blocks, a.id, b.day, b.start, s1.slots);
  const chk = checkEdit(mv.blocks, mv.editedIds, []);
  expect(chk.ok).toBe(false);
  expect(chk.problems.some(p => /two classes at once/.test(p.text))).toBe(true);

  const sw = swapBlocks(blocks, a.id, b.id);
  expect(sw.error).toBeUndefined();
  expect(checkEdit(sw.blocks, sw.editedIds, []).problems.filter(p => /two classes at once/.test(p.text))).toEqual([]);

  const rm = removeBlock(blocks, a.id);
  expect(rm.blocks.length).toBe(blocks.length - 1);
  const add = addBlock(rm.blocks, s1, a.day, a.start, { token: "SPORTS", type: "other", faculty: [], periods: 1 });
  expect(add.error).toBeUndefined();
  expect(add.blocks.length).toBe(blocks.length);
  expect(addBlock(rm.blocks, s1, a.day, 1, { token: "X", periods: 1 }).error).toBeTruthy();
});

test("a faculty change that double-books someone is refused", () => {
  const { blocks } = setup();
  const a = blocks.find(x => x.sectionId === "s1" && x.token === "T1");
  const dr2 = { key: "p2", name: "Dr 2", phone: "p2", external: false };
  const ch = changeFaculty(blocks, a.id, [dr2]);
  const chk = checkEdit(ch.blocks, ch.editedIds, []);
  const busy = blocks.some(x => x.token === "T2" && x.day === a.day && x.start < a.end && a.start < x.end);
  expect(chk.ok).toBe(!busy);
  expect(Array.isArray(loadWarnings(ch.blocks, ch.editedIds))).toBe(true);
});

=== START_FILE: .\src\timetableDesign\generator.js ===

// src/timetableDesign/generator.js
// Builds timetables from the admin's answers. Pure logic: no React, no Firebase.
//
//   buildSpec(...)       turns the answers + what the portal knows into "units" to place and a list of problems
//   designVersions(...)  places every unit several ways and returns the best distinct, clash-free timetables
//
// A unit is one class to place: it covers `size` back-to-back periods and belongs to one or more sections
// (one for an ordinary class, several for a class joined across sections). It carries one block per section/subject
// that sits in it (several for labs that run together as batches). Rules that are never broken: nobody in two places
// at once, the daily limits, availability, clashes with timetables already published for other years, a section's
// one-class-at-a-time. Preferences (avoid first/last period, spread a subject over the week, ...) are weighed, and
// any that had to give way are reported.

import { detectOverlaps } from "../timetableUpload/overlapCheck";
import { buildTimings, periodsOn, contiguous, num, DAY_LONG } from "./designModel";
import { nameKey } from "../timetableUpload/smartParser";

const slug = s => String(s || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
const lower = s => String(s || "").toLowerCase();

function splitSizes(total, block) {
  const out = [];
  let rem = total;
  const b = Math.max(1, block);
  while (rem >= b) { out.push(b); rem -= b; }
  if (rem > 0) out.push(rem);
  return out;
}

// â”€â”€ spec â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// sections: [{ id, name, subjects: [{ name, token, type, faculty: [phone, ...] }] }]
// people:   [{ phone, name }]
// published: blocks already published for OTHER years (they keep their real clock times)
export function buildSpec({ year, a, sections, people, published = [] }) {
  const problems = [];
  const timings = buildTimings(a);
  if (timings.error) return { spec: null, problems: [{ level: "error", step: "time", text: timings.error }] };
  const D = Number(a.days);
  const P = Array.from({ length: D }, (_, d) => periodsOn(a, d));
  const personBy = new Map(people.map(p => [p.phone, p]));
  const facOf = (phone, i) => { const p = personBy.get(phone); return p ? { key: phone, name: p.name, phone, external: false, role: i === 0 ? "main" : "asst" } : null; };

  const maxTotal = num(a.maxTotalPerDay, 4), maxTheory = num(a.maxTheoryPerDay, 3), maxLab = num(a.maxLabPerDay, 1);
  const maxRun = a.consecutive ? Math.max(1, num(a.maxRun, 2)) : 1;

  let uid = 0;
  const units = [];
  const addUnit = u => { units.push({ id: "u" + (++uid), kind: "flex", fixedAt: null, avoidFirst: false, avoidLast: false, ...u }); return units[units.length - 1]; };

  const loadOf = name => a.loads[name] || {};
  const typeOf = sub => { const t = lower(sub.type); return t === "lab" ? "lab" : t === "drawing" ? "drawing" : "theory"; };

  // subjects that are handled by a parallel group or a joint class are skipped in the plain pass
  const consumed = new Set(); // sectionId|subject
  const comboOf = new Map();  // joint spec index -> "C1"..

  // joint classes
  (a.joint || []).forEach((j, ji) => {
    const secs = sections.filter(s => (j.sections || []).includes(s.id) && s.subjects.some(x => x.name === j.subject));
    if (secs.length < 2) { problems.push({ level: "warn", text: "The joint class \"" + j.subject + "\" needs at least two sections that have it. It is being placed separately in each section." }); return; }
    const first = secs[0].subjects.find(x => x.name === j.subject);
    const type = typeOf(first);
    const load = loadOf(j.subject);
    const total = num(load.periods, 0);
    const block = type === "theory" ? Math.max(1, num(load.block, 1)) : Math.max(1, num(load.block, num(a.labBlock, 3)));
    if (total <= 0) { problems.push({ level: "warn", text: "\"" + j.subject + "\" has no periods per week, so it isn't placed." }); secs.forEach(s => consumed.add(s.id + "|" + j.subject)); return; }
    const combo = "C" + (ji + 1);
    comboOf.set(ji, combo);
    splitSizes(total, block).forEach(size => {
      const blocks = secs.map(s => {
        const sub = s.subjects.find(x => x.name === j.subject);
        return { sectionId: s.id, sectionName: s.name, token: sub.token, subject: sub.name, type, faculty: sub.faculty.map((p, i) => facOf(p, i)).filter(Boolean), combo };
      });
      const facs = Array.from(new Set(blocks.flatMap(b => b.faculty.map(f => f.key))));
      addUnit({ size, type, teaching: true, sectionIds: secs.map(s => s.id), blocks, facs, avoidFirst: !!load.avoidFirst, avoidLast: !!load.avoidLast });
    });
    secs.forEach(s => consumed.add(s.id + "|" + j.subject));
  });

  // labs that run together as batches
  (a.parallel || []).forEach(group => {
    if (!group || group.length < 2) return;
    sections.forEach(s => {
      const subs = group.map(n => s.subjects.find(x => x.name === n));
      if (subs.some(x => !x) || subs.some(x => consumed.has(s.id + "|" + x.name))) return;
      const loads = subs.map(x => num(loadOf(x.name).periods, 0));
      if (new Set(loads).size > 1) problems.push({ level: "warn", text: "In " + s.name + " the labs " + group.join(" / ") + " run together but have different periods per week (" + loads.join(", ") + "). The first one's number is used." });
      const total = loads[0];
      if (total <= 0) return;
      const block = Math.max(1, num(loadOf(subs[0].name).block, num(a.labBlock, 3)));
      splitSizes(total, block).forEach(size => {
        const blocks = subs.map(sub => ({ sectionId: s.id, sectionName: s.name, token: sub.token, subject: sub.name, type: typeOf(sub), faculty: sub.faculty.map((p, i) => facOf(p, i)).filter(Boolean), combo: "" }));
        const facs = Array.from(new Set(blocks.flatMap(b => b.faculty.map(f => f.key))));
        addUnit({ size, type: "lab", teaching: true, sectionIds: [s.id], blocks, facs });
      });
      subs.forEach(x => consumed.add(s.id + "|" + x.name));
    });
  });

  // everything else: one subject in one section
  sections.forEach(s => s.subjects.forEach(sub => {
    if (consumed.has(s.id + "|" + sub.name)) return;
    const load = loadOf(sub.name);
    const total = num((load.perSection || {})[s.id], num(load.periods, 0));
    if (!(total > 0)) { if (!load.perSection || (load.perSection || {})[s.id] === undefined) problems.push({ level: "warn", text: s.name + ": \"" + sub.name + "\" has no periods per week, so it isn't placed." }); return; }
    const type = typeOf(sub);
    const block = type === "theory" ? Math.max(1, num(load.block, 1)) : Math.max(1, num(load.block, num(a.labBlock, 3)));
    const sizes = splitSizes(total, block);
    if (type !== "theory" && total % block !== 0) problems.push({ level: "warn", text: s.name + ": " + sub.name + " has " + total + " periods a week, which isn't a multiple of its " + block + "-period sessions. One shorter session of " + (total % block) + " is added." });
    const faculty = sub.faculty.map((p, i) => facOf(p, i)).filter(Boolean);
    if (faculty.length === 0) problems.push({ level: "warn", text: s.name + ": \"" + sub.name + "\" has no faculty assigned in the portal. It is placed without any faculty clash check." });
    if (load.mode === "fixed") {
      const rows = ((load.fixed || {})[s.id] || []).slice(0, total);
      let filled = 0;
      rows.forEach(r => {
        if (r.day === "" || r.day === undefined || r.period === "" || r.period === undefined) return;
        const d = Number(r.day), pp = Number(r.period) - 1;
        if (!(d >= 0 && d < D) || !(pp >= 0 && pp < P[d])) { problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + ": the " + sub.token + " slot " + DAY_LONG[d] + " period " + (pp + 1) + " doesn't exist in your timetable." }); return; }
        filled++;
        addUnit({
          size: 1, type, teaching: true, kind: "fixed", fixedAt: { d, p: pp }, sectionIds: [s.id],
          blocks: [{ sectionId: s.id, sectionName: s.name, token: sub.token, subject: sub.name, type, faculty, combo: "" }],
          facs: faculty.map(f => f.key),
        });
      });
      if (filled < total) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + ": " + sub.name + " is set to fixed slots and needs " + total + " a week, but only " + filled + " " + (filled === 1 ? "has" : "have") + " a day and period. Open Options on that subject and choose them." });
      return;
    }
    sizes.forEach(size => addUnit({
      size, type, teaching: true, sectionIds: [s.id],
      blocks: [{ sectionId: s.id, sectionName: s.name, token: sub.token, subject: sub.name, type, faculty, combo: "" }],
      facs: faculty.map(f => f.key), avoidFirst: !!load.avoidFirst, avoidLast: !!load.avoidLast,
    }));
  }));

  // extra activities: CRT, sports, library ...
  (a.extras || []).forEach(e => {
    const token = String(e.name || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!token) return;
    let trainer = null;
    if (e.sameTrainer && e.trainer) {
      if (e.trainer.kind === "portal" && personBy.has(e.trainer.phone)) trainer = facOf(e.trainer.phone, 0);
      else if (e.trainer.kind === "ext" && String(e.trainer.name || "").trim()) trainer = { key: "ext:" + (nameKey(e.trainer.name) || slug(e.trainer.name)), name: String(e.trainer.name).trim(), phone: null, external: true, role: "main" };
    }
    sections.forEach(s => {
      const n = num((e.perSection || {})[s.id], num(e.periods, 0));
      if (!(n > 0)) return;
      const mk = size => ({
        size, type: "other", teaching: false, sectionIds: [s.id],
        blocks: [{ sectionId: s.id, sectionName: s.name, token, subject: token, type: "other", faculty: trainer ? [trainer] : [], combo: "" }],
        facs: trainer ? [trainer.key] : [],
      });
      if (e.mode === "fixed") {
        const rows = (e.fixed || {})[s.id] || [];
        let filled = 0;
        rows.slice(0, n).forEach(r => {
          if (r.day === "" || r.day === undefined || r.period === "" || r.period === undefined) return;
          const d = Number(r.day), p = Number(r.period) - 1;
          if (!(d >= 0 && d < D) || !(p >= 0 && p < P[d])) { problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + ": the " + token + " slot " + DAY_LONG[d] + " period " + (p + 1) + " doesn't exist in your timetable." }); return; }
          filled++;
          addUnit({ ...mk(1), kind: "fixed", fixedAt: { d, p } });
        });
        if (filled < n) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + ": " + token + " needs " + n + " fixed slot" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s") + " a week but only " + filled + " " + (filled === 1 ? "has" : "have") + " a day and period." });
      } else {
        splitSizes(n, Math.max(1, num(e.block, 1))).forEach(size => addUnit(mk(size)));
      }
    });
  });

  // per-subject, per-section cap on how many periods may fall on one day
  const dayCap = {};
  units.forEach(u => u.blocks.forEach(b => {
    const k = b.sectionId + "|" + b.subject;
    dayCap[k] = Math.max(dayCap[k] || 0, u.size);
  }));
  const totals = {};
  units.forEach(u => u.blocks.forEach(b => { const k = b.sectionId + "|" + b.subject; totals[k] = (totals[k] || 0) + u.size; }));
  Object.keys(dayCap).forEach(k => { dayCap[k] = a.repeatSameDay ? 99 : Math.max(dayCap[k], Math.ceil(totals[k] / D)); });

  // availability
  const blocked = {};
  (a.availability || []).forEach(r => {
    if (!r.phone) return;
    const grid = blocked[r.phone] || (blocked[r.phone] = P.map(n => new Array(n).fill(false)));
    for (let d = 0; d < D; d++) for (let p = 0; p < P[d]; p++) {
      const on = !!(r.cells || {})[d + "-" + p];
      if (r.mode === "only") { if (!on) grid[d][p] = true; } else if (on) grid[d][p] = true;
    }
  });

  // timetables already published for other years: faculty busy by clock time
  const pubBusy = {};
  published.forEach(b => (b.faculty || []).forEach(f => { (pubBusy[f.key] = pubBusy[f.key] || P.map(() => [])); if (b.day < D) pubBusy[f.key][b.day].push([b.start, b.end]); }));

  // ...and how much of their day that already takes, so the daily limits count it too
  const pubUnits = {};
  const pubCounted = new Set();
  published.forEach(b => (b.faculty || []).forEach(f => {
    if (f.external || b.type === "note" || b.day >= D) return;
    if (b.combo) { const id = f.key + "|" + b.day + "|" + b.start + "|" + b.combo; if (pubCounted.has(id)) return; pubCounted.add(id); }
    const cells = [];
    timings.periods.forEach((pr, i) => { if (i < P[b.day] && pr.start < b.end && b.start < pr.end) cells.push(i); });
    (pubUnits[f.key] = pubUnits[f.key] || P.map(() => [])); pubUnits[f.key][b.day].push({ cells, teaching: b.type !== "other", size: b.periods || Math.max(1, cells.length), type: b.type, pub: true });
  }));

  // labs already published for other sections of this year: only matters when labs may not overlap
  const pubLabs = P.map(() => []);
  published.forEach(b => { if ((b.type === "lab" || b.type === "drawing") && b.day < D && (!b.publishedYear || b.publishedYear === year)) pubLabs[b.day].push([b.start, b.end]); });

  const spec = {
    year, a, timings, D, P, units, dayCap, blocked, pubBusy, pubUnits, pubLabs,
    sections: sections.map(s => ({ id: s.id, name: s.name })),
    publishedBlocks: published,
    limits: { maxTotal, maxTheory, maxLab, maxRun },
    adj: timings.periods.map((_, i) => contiguous(timings, i)),
  };

  precheck(spec, problems, people);
  return { spec, problems };
}

// Things that make a timetable impossible whatever the arrangement, said in plain words before any searching.
function precheck(spec, problems, people) {
  const { units, D, P, blocked, limits, a } = spec;
  const nameOf = new Map(people.map(p => [p.phone, p.name]));

  spec.sections.forEach(s => {
    const need = units.filter(u => u.sectionIds.includes(s.id)).reduce((t, u) => t + u.size, 0);
    const have = P.reduce((t, n) => t + n, 0);
    const labSessions = units.filter(u => u.sectionIds.includes(s.id) && (u.type === "lab" || u.type === "drawing")).length;
    if (a.labOnceADay !== false && labSessions > D) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + " has " + labSessions + " lab sessions a week but only " + D + " days, and a section may have just one lab session a day. Reduce the lab sessions, or untick \"One lab session a day\" in Subjects and periods." });
    if (need > have) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + " needs " + need + " periods a week but the week has only " + have + ". Reduce some subjects' periods (Subjects and periods), or add periods or a working day (Days and periods)." });
    else if (need < have && !a.allowBlank) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: s.name + " has " + (have - need) + " blank period" + (have - need === 1 ? "" : "s") + " in the week (" + need + " of " + have + " are filled). A timetable can't have blank periods: add " + (have - need) + " more period" + (have - need === 1 ? "" : "s") + " in Subjects and periods (more periods for a subject, or Library, Tutorials, Sports, Club activities)." });
  });

  // faculty: weekly demand against what the daily limits and availability allow
  const per = {};
  units.forEach(u => u.facs.forEach(key => {
    if (key.startsWith("ext:") || !u.teaching) return;
    const r = per[key] || (per[key] = { total: 0, theory: 0, lab: 0 });
    r.total += u.size;
    if (u.type === "theory") r.theory += u.size; else r.lab += 1;
  }));
  Object.keys(per).forEach(key => {
    const free = d => { let n = 0; for (let p = 0; p < P[d]; p++) if (!(blocked[key] && blocked[key][d][p])) n++; return n; };
    let capTotal = 0, capTheory = 0, capLab = 0;
    for (let d = 0; d < D; d++) {
      let f = free(d), pt = 0, pth = 0, pl = 0, pc = 0;
      ((spec.pubUnits[key] || [])[d] || []).forEach(o => { pc += o.cells.length; if (!o.teaching) return; pt += o.size; if (o.type === "theory") pth += o.size; else pl += 1; });
      f = Math.max(0, f - pc);
      capTotal += Math.max(0, Math.min(limits.maxTotal - pt, f)); capTheory += Math.max(0, Math.min(limits.maxTheory - pth, f)); capLab += Math.max(0, Math.min(limits.maxLab - pl, f));
    }
    const nm = nameOf.get(key) || key, r = per[key];
    const days = Math.max(1, D);
    const hasPub = Object.keys(spec.pubUnits[key] ? { x: 1 } : {}).length > 0 && (spec.pubUnits[key] || []).some(l => l.length);
    const away = (Array.from({ length: D }, (_, d) => P[d] - free(d)).reduce((t, n) => t + n, 0) > 0 ? " and the slots they are unavailable" : "") + (hasPub ? " (counting the classes they already have in published timetables)" : "");
    if (r.total > capTotal) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "lim", text: nm + " has " + r.total + " periods to teach in a week, but with at most " + limits.maxTotal + " periods a day" + away + ", only " + capTotal + " fit. To fix it: raise \"Most periods in a day\" in Faculty limits to at least " + Math.ceil(r.total / days) + ", or give some of " + nm + "'s subjects or sections to another faculty (Sections & Subjects), or reduce their periods." });
    else if (r.theory > capTheory) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "lim", text: nm + " teaches " + r.theory + " theory periods a week, but with at most " + limits.maxTheory + " theory periods a day" + away + ", only " + capTheory + " fit. To fix it: raise \"Most theory periods in a day\" in Faculty limits to at least " + Math.ceil(r.theory / days) + ", or give some of " + nm + "'s theory classes to another faculty, or reduce their periods." });
    else if (r.lab > capLab) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "lim", text: nm + " has " + r.lab + " lab sessions a week, but with at most " + limits.maxLab + " a day" + away + ", only " + capLab + " fit. To fix it: raise \"Most lab sessions in a day\" in Faculty limits to at least " + Math.ceil(r.lab / days) + ", or give a lab to another faculty." });
  });

  // fixed slots must not collide with each other
  const seen = new Map();
  units.filter(u => u.kind === "fixed").forEach(u => {
    const { d, p } = u.fixedAt;
    u.sectionIds.forEach(sid => {
      const k = "s|" + sid + "|" + d + "|" + p;
      if (seen.has(k)) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: DAY_LONG[d] + " period " + (p + 1) + " is given to two fixed activities in " + u.blocks[0].sectionName + " (" + seen.get(k) + " and " + u.blocks[0].token + ")." });
      seen.set(k, u.blocks[0].token);
    });
    u.facs.forEach(key => {
      const k = "f|" + key + "|" + d + "|" + p;
      if (seen.has(k)) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: "The trainer for " + u.blocks[0].token + " is given " + DAY_LONG[d] + " period " + (p + 1) + " in two sections (" + seen.get(k) + " and " + u.blocks[0].sectionName + "). One trainer can't be in two sections at once." });
      seen.set(k, u.blocks[0].sectionName);
    });
  });
  const dayLoad = {};
  units.filter(u => u.kind === "fixed" && u.teaching).forEach(u => u.facs.forEach(key => {
    if (key.startsWith("ext:")) return;
    const { d, p } = u.fixedAt;
    if (blocked[key] && blocked[key][d][p]) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: (nameOf.get(key) || key) + " is marked unavailable on " + DAY_LONG[d] + " period " + (p + 1) + ", but " + u.blocks[0].token + " (" + u.blocks[0].sectionName + ") is fixed there." });
    const k = key + "|" + d;
    const r = dayLoad[k] || (dayLoad[k] = { th: 0, lab: 0, tot: 0 });
    r.tot += u.size; if (u.type === "theory") r.th += u.size; else r.lab += 1;
  }));
  Object.keys(dayLoad).forEach(k => {
    const [key, d] = k.split("|"), r = dayLoad[k];
    if (r.tot > limits.maxTotal || r.th > limits.maxTheory || r.lab > limits.maxLab) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: (nameOf.get(key) || key) + " already has " + r.tot + " fixed period" + (r.tot === 1 ? "" : "s") + " on " + DAY_LONG[d] + ", more than the daily limit. Move a fixed slot to another day, or raise the limit in Faculty limits." });
  });
  if (D < 1) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "time", text: "There are no working days." });
  if (units.length === 0) problems.push({ level: "error", step: "subj", text: "There is nothing to place: no subject has any periods per week." });
}

// â”€â”€ plan â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function mulberry32(seed) {
  let t = seed >>> 0;
  return () => { t += 0x6D2B79F5; let r = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t); r ^= r + Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 7), 61 | r); return ((r ^ (r >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
}

class Plan {
  constructor(spec) {
    this.s = spec;
    this.D = spec.D; this.P = spec.P;
    this.per = spec.timings.periods;
    this.sec = {}; this.secDay = {};
    spec.sections.forEach(x => { this.sec[x.id] = this.P.map(n => new Array(n).fill(null)); this.secDay[x.id] = this.P.map(() => new Set()); });
    this.fac = {}; this.facDay = {};
    this.pos = new Map();
    this.labAt = this.P.map(n => Array.from({ length: n }, () => new Set()));
  }
  isLab(u) { return u.type === "lab" || u.type === "drawing"; }
  facRow(key) {
    if (!this.fac[key]) { this.fac[key] = this.P.map(n => new Array(n).fill(null)); this.facDay[key] = this.P.map(() => new Set()); }
    return this.fac[key];
  }
  fits(u, d, p) {
    if (p < 0 || p + u.size > this.P[d]) return false;
    const crossOk = this.s.a.labAcrossBreak && (u.type === "lab" || u.type === "drawing");
    for (let i = p; i < p + u.size - 1; i++) if (!this.s.adj[i] && !crossOk) return false;
    return true;
  }
  // who is in the way (null when something that can't be moved is: availability, a published class)
  inTheWay(u, d, p) {
    const k = u.size, start = this.per[p].start, end = this.per[p + k - 1].end;
    const out = new Set();
    for (const sid of u.sectionIds) for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) { const o = this.sec[sid][d][q]; if (o && o !== u) out.add(o); }
    if (this.s.a.labsOverlap === false && this.isLab(u)) {
      if ((this.s.pubLabs[d] || []).some(([x, y]) => x < end && start < y)) return null;
      for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) this.labAt[d][q].forEach(o => { if (o !== u && !u.sectionIds.every(s => o.sectionIds.includes(s))) out.add(o); });
    }
    for (const key of u.facs) {
      const bl = this.s.blocked[key];
      if (bl) for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) if (bl[d][q]) return null;
      const pb = this.s.pubBusy[key];
      if (pb && pb[d].some(([x, y]) => x < end && start < y)) return null;
      const row = this.facRow(key)[d];
      for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) { const o = row[q]; if (o && o !== u) out.add(o); }
    }
    return out;
  }
  // limits that depend on what else is placed that day (ignoring the units in `ignore`)
  limitsOk(u, d, p, ignore) {
    const L = this.s.limits;
    if (u.teaching) {
      for (const key of u.facs) {
        if (key.startsWith("ext:")) continue;
        this.facRow(key);
        let th = 0, lab = 0, tot = 0;
        this.facDay[key][d].forEach(o => { if (ignore.has(o) || !o.teaching) return; tot += o.size; if (o.type === "theory") th += o.size; else lab += 1; });
        ((this.s.pubUnits[key] || [])[d] || []).forEach(o => { if (!o.teaching) return; tot += o.size; if (o.type === "theory") th += o.size; else lab += 1; });
        tot += u.size; if (u.type === "theory") th += u.size; else lab += 1;
        if (th > L.maxTheory || lab > L.maxLab || tot > L.maxTotal) return false;
        if (!this.runOk(key, d, u, p, ignore)) return false;
      }
    }
    if ((u.type === "lab" || u.type === "drawing") && this.s.a.labOnceADay !== false) {
      for (const sid of u.sectionIds) {
        let labs = 0;
        this.secDay[sid][d].forEach(o => { if (!ignore.has(o) && (o.type === "lab" || o.type === "drawing")) labs++; });
        if (labs > 0) return false;
      }
    }
    for (const b of u.blocks) {
      const k = b.sectionId + "|" + b.subject;
      let have = 0;
      this.secDay[b.sectionId][d].forEach(o => { if (ignore.has(o)) return; o.blocks.forEach(x => { if (x.sectionId === b.sectionId && x.subject === b.subject) have += o.size; }); });
      if (have + u.size > (this.s.dayCap[k] || 99)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  runOk(key, d, u, p, ignore) {
    const n = this.P[d], occ = new Array(n).fill(null), row = this.fac[key][d];
    for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) { const o = row[q]; if (o && !ignore.has(o) && o.teaching) occ[q] = o; }
    ((this.s.pubUnits[key] || [])[d] || []).forEach(o => { if (o.teaching) o.cells.forEach(q => { if (!occ[q]) occ[q] = o; }); });
    for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) occ[q] = u;
    let chain = 0, prev = null;
    for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) {
      if (q > 0 && !this.s.adj[q - 1]) { chain = 0; prev = null; }
      const o = occ[q];
      if (o) { if (o !== prev) { chain++; prev = o; } if (chain > this.s.limits.maxRun) return false; } else { chain = 0; prev = null; }
    }
    return true;
  }
  cost(u, d, p, rnd) {
    const a = this.s.a;
    let c = 0;
    const last = p + u.size - 1 === this.P[d] - 1;
    if (u.avoidFirst && p === 0) c += 60;
    if (u.avoidLast && last) c += 60;
    for (const b of u.blocks) {
      let today = 0;
      this.secDay[b.sectionId][d].forEach(o => o.blocks.forEach(x => { if (x.sectionId === b.sectionId && x.subject === b.subject) today += o.size; }));
      c += today * 40;
      for (const dd of [d - 1, d + 1]) if (dd >= 0 && dd < this.D) this.secDay[b.sectionId][dd].forEach(o => o.blocks.forEach(x => { if (x.sectionId === b.sectionId && x.subject === b.subject) c += 3; }));
      let filled = 0;
      this.sec[b.sectionId][d].forEach(o => { if (o) filled++; });
      c += filled * 1.2;
    }
    for (const key of u.facs) {
      if (key.startsWith("ext:")) continue;
      this.facRow(key);
      let tot = 0;
      this.facDay[key][d].forEach(o => { if (o.teaching) tot += o.size; });
      ((this.s.pubUnits[key] || [])[d] || []).forEach(o => { if (o.teaching) tot += o.size; });
      c += tot * 3;
    }
    if (u.type === "lab" || u.type === "drawing") {
      const half = Math.ceil(this.P[d] / 2);
      if (a.labPref === "morning" && p >= half) c += 25;
      if (a.labPref === "afternoon" && p < half) c += 25;
    }
    c += p * 0.8 + rnd() * 7;
    return c;
  }
  place(u, d, p) {
    for (const sid of u.sectionIds) { for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) this.sec[sid][d][q] = u; this.secDay[sid][d].add(u); }
    for (const key of u.facs) { const row = this.facRow(key)[d]; for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) row[q] = u; this.facDay[key][d].add(u); }
    if (this.isLab(u)) for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) this.labAt[d][q].add(u);
    this.pos.set(u, { d, p });
  }
  unplace(u) {
    const at = this.pos.get(u);
    if (!at) return;
    const { d, p } = at;
    for (const sid of u.sectionIds) { for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) this.sec[sid][d][q] = null; this.secDay[sid][d].delete(u); }
    for (const key of u.facs) { const row = this.fac[key][d]; for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) row[q] = null; this.facDay[key][d].delete(u); }
    if (this.isLab(u)) for (let q = p; q < p + u.size; q++) this.labAt[d][q].delete(u);
    this.pos.delete(u);
  }
  positions(u) {
    const out = [];
    for (let d = 0; d < this.D; d++) for (let p = 0; p + u.size <= this.P[d]; p++) if (this.fits(u, d, p)) out.push([d, p]);
    return out;
  }
  // the cheapest place that breaks no rule
  bestFree(u, rnd) {
    let best = null;
    for (const [d, p] of this.positions(u)) {
      const way = this.inTheWay(u, d, p);
      if (!way || way.size > 0) continue;
      if (!this.limitsOk(u, d, p, EMPTY)) continue;
      const c = this.cost(u, d, p, rnd);
      if (!best || c < best.c) best = { d, p, c };
    }
    return best;
  }
  // when nothing is free: the place that needs the fewest other classes moved out of the way
  bestByMoving(u, rnd) {
    let best = null;
    for (const [d, p] of this.positions(u)) {
      const way = this.inTheWay(u, d, p);
      if (!way || way.size === 0 || way.size > 3) continue;
      let ok = true;
      way.forEach(o => { if (o.kind === "fixed") ok = false; });
      if (!ok || !this.limitsOk(u, d, p, way)) continue;
      let pen = way.size * 200;
      way.forEach(o => { pen += (o.moved || 0) * 40; });
      const c = pen + this.cost(u, d, p, rnd);
      if (!best || c < best.c) best = { d, p, c, way };
    }
    return best;
  }
  // why a unit has nowhere to go, in plain words
  why(u) {
    const reasons = { section: 0, faculty: 0, away: 0, limit: 0, labs: 0 };
    let who = null;
    for (const [d, p] of this.positions(u)) {
      const k = u.size, start = this.per[p].start, end = this.per[p + k - 1].end;
      let secBusy = false;
      for (const sid of u.sectionIds) for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) if (this.sec[sid][d][q]) secBusy = true;
      if (secBusy) { reasons.section++; continue; }
      if (this.s.a.labsOverlap === false && this.isLab(u)) {
        let other = (this.s.pubLabs[d] || []).some(([x, y]) => x < end && start < y);
        for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) this.labAt[d][q].forEach(o => { if (o !== u) other = true; });
        if (other) { reasons.labs++; continue; }
      }
      let away = false, busy = false;
      for (const key of u.facs) {
        const bl = this.s.blocked[key];
        if (bl) for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) if (bl[d][q]) { away = true; who = who || key; }
        const pb = this.s.pubBusy[key];
        if (pb && pb[d].some(([x, y]) => x < end && start < y)) { away = true; who = who || key; }
        const row = this.facRow(key)[d];
        for (let q = p; q < p + k; q++) if (row[q]) { busy = true; who = who || key; }
      }
      if (away) { reasons.away++; continue; }
      if (busy) { reasons.faculty++; continue; }
      reasons.limit++;
    }
    return { reasons, who };
  }
}
const EMPTY = new Set();

// â”€â”€ generation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function difficulty(spec, u, rnd, load) {
  let w = u.size * 10 + u.facs.length * 3 + u.sectionIds.length * 4;
  u.facs.forEach(k => { w += (load[k] || 0) / 6; });
  if (u.type === "lab" || u.type === "drawing") w += 8;
  if (u.avoidFirst || u.avoidLast) w += 2;
  return w + rnd() * 4;
}

export function generate(spec, seed) {
  const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
  const plan = new Plan(spec);
  const load = {};
  spec.units.forEach(u => u.facs.forEach(k => { load[k] = (load[k] || 0) + u.size; }));
  const units = spec.units.map(u => { u.moved = 0; return u; });

  const failures = [];
  units.filter(u => u.kind === "fixed").forEach(u => {
    const { d, p } = u.fixedAt;
    const way = plan.inTheWay(u, d, p);
    if (!way || way.size > 0 || !plan.fits(u, d, p)) failures.push(u); else plan.place(u, d, p);
  });

  const queue = units.filter(u => u.kind !== "fixed").map(u => ({ u, w: difficulty(spec, u, rnd, load) })).sort((x, y) => y.w - x.w).map(x => x.u);
  let steps = 0;
  const MAX = 4000 + units.length * 60;
  const stuck = [];
  while (queue.length && steps < MAX) {
    steps++;
    const u = queue.shift();
    const free = plan.bestFree(u, rnd);
    if (free) { plan.place(u, free.d, free.p); continue; }
    const mv = u.moved > 40 ? null : plan.bestByMoving(u, rnd);
    if (!mv) { stuck.push(u); continue; }
    mv.way.forEach(o => { plan.unplace(o); o.moved = (o.moved || 0) + 1; queue.push(o); });
    u.moved++;
    plan.place(u, mv.d, mv.p);
  }
  const unplaced = failures.concat(queue, stuck);
  return { plan, unplaced };
}

// blocks in the same shape the upload reads, so the same overlap check and publish steps work on them
function toBlocks(spec, plan) {
  const out = [];
  plan.pos.forEach((at, u) => {
    const { d, p } = at;
    const start = spec.timings.periods[p].start, end = spec.timings.periods[p + u.size - 1].end;
    u.blocks.forEach(b => out.push({
      id: b.sectionId + ":" + d + ":" + start + ":" + b.token,
      sectionId: b.sectionId, sectionName: b.sectionName, day: d, start, end,
      token: b.token, subject: b.subject, type: b.type, faculty: b.faculty, combo: b.combo || "", periods: u.size, source: "design",
    }));
  });
  return out.sort((x, y) => x.sectionId.localeCompare(y.sectionId) || x.day - y.day || x.start - y.start);
}

// preferences that had to give way
function relaxed(spec, plan) {
  const out = [];
  const last = d => spec.P[d] - 1;
  plan.pos.forEach((at, u) => {
    const { d, p } = at;
    u.blocks.forEach(b => {
      if (u.avoidFirst && p === 0) out.push(b.sectionName + ": " + b.token + " is in the first period on " + DAY_LONG[d] + ".");
      if (u.avoidLast && p + u.size - 1 === last(d)) out.push(b.sectionName + ": " + b.token + " is in the last period on " + DAY_LONG[d] + ".");
    });
  });
  const seen = new Set();
  plan.pos.forEach((at, u) => {
    u.blocks.forEach(b => {
      const k = b.sectionId + "|" + b.subject + "|" + at.d;
      if (u.size === 1 && !spec.a.repeatSameDay) {
        const n = Array.from(plan.secDay[b.sectionId][at.d]).filter(o => o.blocks.some(x => x.subject === b.subject)).length;
        if (n > 1 && !seen.has(k)) { seen.add(k); out.push(b.sectionName + ": " + b.token + " comes twice on " + DAY_LONG[at.d] + "."); }
      }
    });
  });
  return out;
}

// every hard rule, re-checked on the finished blocks (the generator's own bookkeeping isn't trusted)
export function verify(spec, blocks) {
  const issues = [];
  const conflicts = detectOverlaps(blocks, spec.publishedBlocks.map(b => ({ ...b })));
  conflicts.forEach(c => issues.push(c.name + " is double-booked on " + DAY_LONG[c.day] + " (" + c.a.sectionName + " " + c.a.token + " and " + c.b.sectionName + " " + c.b.token + ")."));
  const L = spec.limits;
  const per = {};
  const counted = new Set();
  blocks.forEach(b => {
    if (b.type === "other") return;
    b.faculty.forEach(f => {
      if (f.external) return;
      if (b.combo) { const id = f.key + "|" + b.day + "|" + b.start + "|" + b.combo; if (counted.has(id)) return; counted.add(id); }
      const r = per[f.key + "|" + b.day] || (per[f.key + "|" + b.day] = { name: f.name, day: b.day, th: 0, lab: 0, tot: 0 });
      r.tot += b.periods;
      if (b.type === "theory") r.th += b.periods; else r.lab += 1;
    });
  });
  if (spec.a.labOnceADay !== false) {
    const labDays = {};
    blocks.forEach(b => {
      if (b.type !== "lab" && b.type !== "drawing") return;
      const k = b.sectionId + "|" + b.day + "|" + b.start + "|" + b.end;       // batches that run together share one slot
      (labDays[b.sectionId + "|" + b.day] = labDays[b.sectionId + "|" + b.day] || new Set()).add(k);
    });
    Object.keys(labDays).forEach(k => { if (labDays[k].size > 1) { const [sid, d] = k.split("|"); const nm = (blocks.find(b => b.sectionId === sid) || {}).sectionName || sid; issues.push(nm + " has more than one lab session on " + DAY_LONG[Number(d)] + "."); } });
  }
  if (spec.a.labsOverlap === false) {
    const labs = blocks.filter(b => b.type === "lab" || b.type === "drawing");
    for (let i = 0; i < labs.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < labs.length; j++) {
        const x = labs[i], y = labs[j];
        if (x.sectionId === y.sectionId || x.day !== y.day || !(x.start < y.end && y.start < x.end)) continue;
        if (x.combo && x.combo === y.combo) continue;
        issues.push("Labs of " + x.sectionName + " (" + x.token + ") and " + y.sectionName + " (" + y.token + ") are at the same time on " + DAY_LONG[x.day] + ".");
      }
    }
    labs.forEach(x => { if ((spec.pubLabs[x.day] || []).some(([s, e]) => s < x.end && x.start < e)) issues.push(x.sectionName + " " + x.token + " is at the same time as a lab already published for another section, on " + DAY_LONG[x.day] + "."); });
  }
  const touched = new Set(Object.keys(per));
  const pubDone = new Set();
  spec.publishedBlocks.forEach(b => (b.faculty || []).forEach(f => {
    if (f.external || b.type === "other" || b.type === "note") return;
    const k = f.key + "|" + b.day;
    if (!touched.has(k)) return;
    if (b.combo) { const id = f.key + "|" + b.day + "|" + b.start + "|" + b.combo; if (pubDone.has(id)) return; pubDone.add(id); }
    const r = per[k];
    r.tot += b.periods || 1;
    if (b.type === "theory") r.th += b.periods || 1; else r.lab += 1;
  }));
  Object.values(per).forEach(r => {
    if (r.th > L.maxTheory) issues.push(r.name + " has " + r.th + " theory periods on " + DAY_LONG[r.day] + ".");
    if (r.lab > L.maxLab) issues.push(r.name + " has " + r.lab + " lab sessions on " + DAY_LONG[r.day] + ".");
    if (r.tot > L.maxTotal) issues.push(r.name + " has " + r.tot + " periods on " + DAY_LONG[r.day] + ".");
  });
  return issues;
}

function signature(plan) {
  const parts = [];
  plan.pos.forEach((at, u) => parts.push(u.id + "@" + at.d + "," + at.p));
  return parts.sort().join("|");
}
function similarity(a, b) {
  const A = new Set(a.split("|")), B = b.split("|");
  let same = 0;
  B.forEach(x => { if (A.has(x)) same++; });
  return same / Math.max(1, B.length);
}

// Reasons, in plain words, why these units could not be placed.
function explain(spec, plan, unplaced, people) {
  const nameOf = new Map(people.map(p => [p.phone, p.name]));
  return unplaced.slice(0, 12).map(u => {
    const b = u.blocks[0];
    const { reasons, who } = plan.why(u);
    const total = reasons.section + reasons.faculty + reasons.away + reasons.limit + reasons.labs;
    let why = "";
    if (total === 0) why = "no place has " + u.size + " free back-to-back period" + (u.size === 1 ? "" : "s") + " in a row";
    else {
      const top = Object.entries(reasons).sort((x, y) => y[1] - x[1])[0][0];
      const person = who ? (nameOf.get(who) || who) : "a faculty member";
      why = top === "labs" ? "you chose that labs of different sections may not run at the same time, and another section's lab is in every period that is free here"
        : top === "section" ? "the section's periods are already full where " + person + " could take it"
        : top === "faculty" ? person + " is already teaching in every period that is free for the section"
        : top === "away" ? person + " is unavailable, or busy in another year's published timetable, in every period that is free"
        : "every free period would break a daily limit (theory, lab, total or back-to-back) for " + person;
    }
    return "Could not place " + b.token + " (" + u.blocks.map(x => x.sectionName).filter((v, i, arr) => arr.indexOf(v) === i).join(", ") + ", " + u.size + " period" + (u.size === 1 ? "" : "s") + "): " + why + ".";
  });
}

// Several distinct, clash-free versions. `skip` are signatures of versions already shown.
export function designVersions(spec, people, { count = 3, tries = 60, skip = [], timeMs = 8000, seed = Date.now() } = {}) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const found = [];
  let bestPartial = null, attempts = 0, completes = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < tries && Date.now() - t0 < timeMs; i++) {
    attempts++;
    const { plan, unplaced } = generate(spec, seed + i * 7919);
    if (unplaced.length) {
      if (!bestPartial || unplaced.length < bestPartial.unplaced.length) bestPartial = { plan, unplaced };
      continue;
    }
    const blocks = toBlocks(spec, plan);
    const issues = verify(spec, blocks);
    if (issues.length) continue;
    completes++;
    const sig = signature(plan);
    if (skip.includes(sig) || found.some(f => f.sig === sig)) continue;
    const rel = relaxed(spec, plan);
    found.push({ sig, blocks, relaxed: rel, cost: rel.length });
    if (found.length >= count * 4) break;
  }
  found.sort((x, y) => x.cost - y.cost);
  const chosen = [];
  [0.85, 0.95, 1.01].forEach(limit => {
    found.forEach(f => {
      if (chosen.length >= count || chosen.includes(f)) return;
      if (chosen.every(c => similarity(c.sig, f.sig) < limit)) chosen.push(f);
    });
  });
  const result = { versions: chosen, attempts, completes, problems: [] };
  if (chosen.length === 0 && bestPartial) result.problems = explain(spec, bestPartial.plan, bestPartial.unplaced, people);
  return result;
}

import { buildSpec, designVersions, verify } from "./generator";
import { defaultAnswers, newExtra } from "./designModel";

function scenario(extra) {
  const people = [
    ["p1", "Dr A One"], ["p2", "Dr B Two"], ["p3", "Dr C Three"], ["p4", "Dr D Four"], ["p5", "Dr E Five"],
    ["p6", "Dr F Six"], ["p7", "Dr G Seven"], ["p8", "Dr H Eight"],
  ].map(([phone, name]) => ({ phone, name }));
  const mk = (id, name) => ({
    id, name,
    subjects: [
      { name: "S&GPS", token: "S&GPS", type: "Theory", faculty: ["p1"] },
      { name: "DMM", token: "DMM", type: "Theory", faculty: ["p2"] },
      { name: "AIML", token: "AIML", type: "Theory", faculty: ["p3"] },
      { name: "MTM", token: "MTM", type: "Theory", faculty: ["p4"] },
      { name: "IIR", token: "IIR", type: "Theory", faculty: ["p5"] },
      { name: "Thermal Lab", token: "TL", type: "Lab", faculty: ["p6", "p8"] },
      { name: "Metrology Lab", token: "ML", type: "Lab", faculty: ["p7"] },
    ],
  });
  const sections = [mk("s1", "III YR I SEM SL-1"), mk("s2", "III YR I SEM AL-1"), mk("s3", "III YR I SEM SL-2")];
  const a = defaultAnswers(); a.allowBlank = true;
  ["S&GPS", "DMM", "AIML", "MTM", "IIR"].forEach(n => { a.loads[n] = { periods: 4, block: 1 }; });
  ["Thermal Lab", "Metrology Lab"].forEach(n => { a.loads[n] = { periods: 3, block: 3 }; });
  if (extra) extra(a, sections);
  return { people, sections, a };
}

function run(extra, opts = {}) {
  const { people, sections, a } = scenario(extra);
  const { spec, problems } = buildSpec({ year: "III", a, sections, people, published: [] });
  const errors = problems.filter(p => p.level === "error");
  if (errors.length || !spec) return { errors, problems };
  const res = designVersions(spec, people, { count: 3, seed: 12345, ...opts });
  return { spec, problems, res };
}

import React from "react";
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";

const mockMaster = { current: null };
jest.mock("../firebase", () => ({ db: {} }));
jest.mock("firebase/firestore", () => ({
  collection: (_db, name) => ({ __name: name }),

test("a designed workbook is read back into the same classes with the same faculty", () => {
  const sections = [mk("s1", "III YR I SEM SL-1"), mk("s2", "III YR I SEM AL-1")];
  const a = defaultAnswers(); a.allowBlank = true;
  ["S&GPS", "DMM", "AIML"].forEach(n => { a.loads[n] = { periods: 4, block: 1 }; });
  ["Thermal Lab", "Metrology Lab"].forEach(n => { a.loads[n] = { periods: 3, block: 3 }; });
  a.parallel = [["Thermal Lab", "Metrology Lab"]];
  const crt = newExtra("CRT"); crt.periods = 2; crt.sameTrainer = true; crt.trainer = { kind: "ext", phone: "", name: "Ramesh Babu" };
  a.extras = [crt];
  const { spec } = buildSpec({ year: "III", a, sections, people, published: [] });
  const res = designVersions(spec, people, { count: 3, seed: 7 });
  expect(res.versions.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);

  const wbOut = buildDesignWorkbook(spec, res.versions);
  const buf = XLSXS.write(wbOut, { type: "array", bookType: "xlsx" });
  const wbIn = XLSX.read(buf, { type: "array" });

  res.versions.forEach((v, i) => {
    const ctx = {
      year: "III", people, sheets: ["TT-" + (i + 1)],
      sections: sections.map(s => ({ id: s.id, name: s.name, subjects: s.subjects.map(x => ({ name: x.name, short: x.short, type: x.type, faculty: x.faculty })) })),
    };
    const parse = parseSmart(wbIn, ctx, {});
    expect(parse.problems.filter(p => p.level === "error")).toEqual([]);
    expect(parse.pending).toEqual([]);
    const blocks = groupBlocks(parse.entries, "upload");
    // same classes at the same times for the same people (compare without notes)
    const sig = bs => bs.filter(b => b.type !== "note").map(b => [b.sectionId, b.day, b.start, b.end, b.token, b.faculty.map(f => f.key).sort().join("+")].join("|")).sort();
    const expected = v.blocks.map(b => ({ ...b, faculty: b.faculty }));
    expect(sig(blocks)).toEqual(sig(expected));
    expect(detectOverlaps(blocks, [])).toEqual([]);
  });
});
