// src/timetableDesign/steps.jsx
// The question screens of "Design a timetable". Each takes { a, set, ctx }: the answers so far, a function that
// changes some of them, and what the portal already knows (sections, subjects, faculty, timings).

import React from "react";
import { P, Btn } from "../components/UI";
import { parseTimeToken, fmtClock } from "../timetableUpload/timeUtils";
import { buildTimings, validateTimings, periodsOn, DAY_LONG, DAY_ABBR } from "./designModel";

const MONO = "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";
export const inp = { border: "1.5px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 10px", fontSize: 14, fontFamily: "inherit", background: "#fff", boxSizing: "border-box" };
export const small = { fontSize: 12.5, color: P.gray, lineHeight: 1.6 };
export const lbl = { display: "block", fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.04em", textTransform: "uppercase", color: P.gray, marginBottom: 6 };

export function Q({ title, hint, children }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ padding: "14px 0", borderTop: "1px solid " + P.border }}>
      <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14.5, marginBottom: hint ? 3 : 8 }}>{title}</div>
      {hint && <div style={{ ...small, marginBottom: 8 }}>{hint}</div>}
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Radio({ checked, onChange, children }) {
  return (
    <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", padding: "3px 0" }}>
      <input type="radio" checked={checked} onChange={onChange} style={{ accentColor: P.blue }} />{children}
    </label>
  );
}
export function Check({ checked, onChange, children }) {
  return (
    <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", padding: "3px 0" }}>
      <input type="checkbox" checked={!!checked} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.checked)} style={{ accentColor: P.blue, width: 16, height: 16 }} />{children}
    </label>
  );
}
export function NumIn({ value, onChange, width = 80, min = 0, max, placeholder }) {
  return <input type="number" min={min} max={max} value={value === undefined || value === null ? "" : value} placeholder={placeholder} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} style={{ ...inp, width }} />;
}


// â”€â”€ Step: year â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function YearWarnings({ ctx }) {
  const w = (ctx && ctx.yearWarnings) || [];
  if (!w.length) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#1a2230", background: P.amberL, border: "1px solid " + P.amber, borderRadius: 8, padding: "10px 12px", margin: "10px 0", lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
      <b style={{ color: P.amber }}>Please check the section's year</b>
      {w.map(x => <div key={x.id} style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{x.text}</div>)}
      <div style={{ marginTop: 6, color: P.gray }}>To correct it: Coordinator Duties â€º All Sections â€º Sections & Subjects, and set the right year for that section. Nothing has been changed for you.</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StepYear({ ctx, year, setYear, setSelected, published = [] }) {
  const pubDoc = published.find(p => p.year === year);
  const isPublished = id => !!pubDoc && (pubDoc.blocks || []).some(b => b.sectionId === id);
  const chosen = ctx.selectedIds || [];
  const toggle = id => setSelected(chosen.includes(id) ? chosen.filter(x => x !== id) : chosen.concat(id));
  return (
    <>
      <Q title="Which year is this timetable for?" hint="The portal already knows that year's sections, subjects and faculty, so you won't be asked for them again.">
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          {["I", "II", "III", "IV"].map(y => (
            <button key={y} onClick={() => setYear(y)} style={{ padding: "9px 20px", borderRadius: 9, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", border: "1.5px solid " + (year === y ? P.blue : P.border), background: year === y ? P.blue : "#fff", color: year === y ? "#fff" : P.navy }}>Year {y}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Q>
      {ctx.allSections.length > 0 && (
        <Q title="Which section?" hint="Tick the section you want to design. One section at a time is the usual way; tick more than one only if you want them designed together (needed for a class taken by several sections jointly).">
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))", gap: 10 }}>
            {ctx.allSections.map(s => {
              const on = chosen.includes(s.id);
              return (
                <label key={s.id} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, cursor: "pointer", padding: "11px 14px", borderRadius: 10, border: "1.5px solid " + (on ? P.blue : P.border), background: on ? P.blueL : "#fff" }}>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={on} onChange={() => toggle(s.id)} style={{ accentColor: P.blue, width: 17, height: 17 }} />
                  <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <b style={{ fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 13.5 }}>{s.name}</b>
                    <span style={{ display: "block", fontSize: 12, color: P.gray }}>{s.subjects.length} subjects{isPublished(s.id) ? " Â· timetable already published" : ""}</span>
                  </span>
                </label>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
            <Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSelected(ctx.allSections.map(s => s.id))}>Select all</Btn>
            <Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSelected([])}>Clear</Btn>
          </div>
        </Q>
      )}
      {ctx.allSections.length > 0 && ctx.yearSections.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: P.gray, padding: "4px 0" }}>No section is chosen yet. Tick the section you want to design above.</div>
      ) : ctx.yearSections.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.amber, background: P.amberL, borderRadius: 8, padding: "10px 12px" }}>No sections found for Year {year}. Add them under Coordinator Duties â€º All Sections â€º Sections & Subjects (section names start with the year, like III-A).</div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ ...small }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: P.navy, marginBottom: 6 }}>What the portal has for Year {year}{ctx.yearSections.length ? ", for the section" + (ctx.yearSections.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " you are designing" : ""}</div>
          {ctx.yearSections.map(s => (
            <div key={s.id} style={{ padding: "3px 0" }}><b style={{ fontFamily: MONO, color: "#1a2230" }}>{s.name}</b> Â· {s.subjects.length} subjects, {s.subjects.filter(x => x.faculty.length === 0).length === 0 ? "all with faculty" : s.subjects.filter(x => x.faculty.length === 0).length + " without faculty"}</div>
          ))}
          <YearWarnings ctx={ctx} />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

// â”€â”€ Step: days and periods â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function StepTimings({ a, set }) {
  const T = buildTimings(a);
  const problems = validateTimings(a);
  const parsed = parseTimeToken(a.firstStart);
  const setBreak = (i, patch) => set({ breaks: a.breaks.map((b, k) => (k === i ? { ...b, ...patch } : b)) });
  const days = a.days === 6 ? 6 : 5;
  return (
    <>
      <Q title="Working days">
        <Radio checked={days === 5} onChange={() => set({ days: 5 })}>Monday to Friday</Radio>
        <Radio checked={days === 6} onChange={() => set({ days: 6 })}>Monday to Saturday</Radio>
        {days === 6 && (
          <div style={{ marginLeft: 26, marginTop: 6 }}>
            <Radio checked={!a.satHalf} onChange={() => set({ satHalf: false })}>Saturday is a full day</Radio>
            <Radio checked={!!a.satHalf} onChange={() => set({ satHalf: true })}>Saturday is a half day, with <NumIn value={a.satPeriods} onChange={v => set({ satPeriods: v })} width={64} min={1} max={12} /> periods</Radio>
          </div>
        )}
      </Q>
      <Q title="Periods and timings" hint="Tell me the basics. I'll work out every period's time below, and you can change any of them.">
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 18, flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
          <div><span style={lbl}>Periods per day</span><NumIn value={a.periodsPerDay} onChange={v => set({ periodsPerDay: v })} width={90} min={1} max={12} /></div>
          <div>
            <span style={lbl}>First period starts at</span>
            <input value={a.firstStart} onChange={e => set({ firstStart: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inp, width: 110 }} placeholder="9:00" />
            {parsed !== null && <span style={{ ...small, marginLeft: 8 }}>= {fmtClock(parsed)}</span>}
          </div>
          <div><span style={lbl}>Normal period length (minutes)</span><NumIn value={a.periodMins} onChange={v => set({ periodMins: v })} width={90} min={5} max={240} /></div>
        </div>
      </Q>
      <Q title="Breaks" hint="Add the short break and the lunch break, if any. Say after which period each one comes and how long it is.">
        {a.breaks.map((b, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", padding: "5px 0" }}>
            <select value={b.label} onChange={e => setBreak(i, { label: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inp, width: 150 }}>
              {["Break", "Short break", "Lunch"].map(x => <option key={x}>{x}</option>)}
            </select>
            <span style={small}>after period</span><NumIn value={b.after} onChange={v => setBreak(i, { after: v })} width={64} min={1} max={11} />
            <span style={small}>for</span><NumIn value={b.mins} onChange={v => setBreak(i, { mins: v })} width={70} min={1} max={180} /><span style={small}>minutes</span>
            <Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => set({ breaks: a.breaks.filter((_, k) => k !== i) })}>Remove</Btn>
          </div>
        ))}
        <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={() => set({ breaks: [...a.breaks, { after: 1, mins: 10, label: "Break" }] })}>+ Add a break</Btn>
      </Q>

      {problems.map((p, i) => <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 13, color: p.level === "error" ? P.red : P.amber, background: p.level === "error" ? P.redL : P.amberL, borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 12px", margin: "8px 0" }}>{p.text}</div>)}

      {!T.error && (
        <Q title="Here are the timings" hint="Is this right? If a period is longer or shorter than the rest (say the first period, or the afternoon ones), change its length here and the rest move along.">
          <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
            <table style={{ borderCollapse: "collapse", minWidth: 420 }}>
              <thead><tr>{["Period", "From", "To", "Minutes"].map(h => <th key={h} style={{ textAlign: "left", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.04em", color: P.gray, padding: "6px 14px 6px 0", borderBottom: "1.5px solid " + P.border }}>{h}</th>)}</tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {T.slots.map((s, i) => s.brk ? (
                  <tr key={i} style={{ background: "#f6efdc" }}>
                    <td style={{ padding: "6px 14px 6px 8px", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: "#6b4e16" }}>{s.label}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: "6px 14px 6px 0", fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 13 }}>{fmtClock(s.start)}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: "6px 14px 6px 0", fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 13 }}>{fmtClock(s.end)}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: "4px 0" }}><NumIn value={a.breaks.find(b => Number(b.after) === T.slots[i - 1].n).mins} onChange={v => setBreak(a.breaks.findIndex(b => Number(b.after) === T.slots[i - 1].n), { mins: v })} width={70} min={1} max={180} /></td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  <tr key={i}>
                    <td style={{ padding: "6px 14px 6px 8px", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700 }}>Period {s.n}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: "6px 14px 6px 0", fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 13 }}>{fmtClock(s.start)}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: "6px 14px 6px 0", fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 13 }}>{fmtClock(s.end)}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: "4px 0" }}><NumIn value={(a.periodOverrides || {})[s.n] ?? a.periodMins} onChange={v => set({ periodOverrides: { ...(a.periodOverrides || {}), [s.n]: v } })} width={70} min={5} max={240} /></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...small, marginTop: 8 }}>The day ends at {fmtClock(T.dayEnd)}{days === 6 && a.satHalf ? "; Saturday uses the first " + periodsOn(a, 5) + " periods." : "."}</div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: "10px 12px", borderRadius: 9, background: a.timingsConfirmed ? P.greenL : P.bg, border: "1.5px solid " + (a.timingsConfirmed ? P.green : P.border) }}>
            <Check checked={a.timingsConfirmed} onChange={v => set({ timingsConfirmed: v })}><b>Yes, these timings are correct</b></Check>
          </div>
        </Q>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

// â”€â”€ Step: together â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function StepTogether({ a, set, ctx }) {
  const labs = ctx.subjects.filter(s => s.type !== "Theory");
  const toggleIn = (list, v) => (list.includes(v) ? list.filter(x => x !== v) : [...list, v]);
  return (
    <>
      <Q title="Labs that run at the same time (batches)" hint="If the batches of a section do different labs in the same slot (for example batch 1 in one lab and batch 2 in another), tick those labs together. They are then placed in the same periods, each with its own faculty. Leave this empty if every lab runs on its own.">
        {a.parallel.map((g, gi) => (
          <div key={gi} style={{ border: "1.5px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "2px 18px" }}>
              {labs.map(l => <Check key={l.name} checked={g.includes(l.name)} onChange={() => set({ parallel: a.parallel.map((x, k) => (k === gi ? toggleIn(x, l.name) : x)) })}>{l.name}</Check>)}
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}><Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => set({ parallel: a.parallel.filter((_, k) => k !== gi) })}>Remove this group</Btn></div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {labs.length < 2 ? <div style={small}>This year has fewer than two lab subjects, so there is nothing to group.</div> : <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={() => set({ parallel: [...a.parallel, []] })}>+ Add a group of labs</Btn>}
      </Q>
      <Q title="Classes taken by several sections together" hint="An elective or a combined class that two or more sections attend at the same time with the same faculty. Pick the subject and the sections that join.">
        {ctx.yearSections.length < 2 && <div style={{ ...small, marginBottom: 8 }}>You are designing one section, so there is nothing to join. To design a joint class, go to the Year tab and tick two or more sections.</div>}
        {a.joint.map((j, ji) => {
          const subj = ctx.subjects.find(s => s.name === j.subject);
          const setJ = patch => set({ joint: a.joint.map((x, k) => (k === ji ? { ...x, ...patch } : x)) });
          return (
            <div key={ji} style={{ border: "1.5px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <select value={j.subject} onChange={e => setJ({ subject: e.target.value, sections: [] })} style={{ ...inp, width: 260 }}>
                <option value="">Choose a subjectâ€¦</option>
                {ctx.subjects.filter(s => s.sections.length > 1).map(s => <option key={s.name} value={s.name}>{s.name}</option>)}
              </select>
              {subj && <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "2px 18px", marginTop: 6 }}>{subj.sections.map(sec => <Check key={sec.id} checked={j.sections.includes(sec.id)} onChange={() => setJ({ sections: toggleIn(j.sections, sec.id) })}>{sec.name}</Check>)}</div>}
              <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}><Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => set({ joint: a.joint.filter((_, k) => k !== ji) })}>Remove</Btn></div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={() => set({ joint: [...a.joint, { subject: "", sections: [] }] })}>+ Add a joint class</Btn>
      </Q>
    </>
  );
}

// â”€â”€ Step: faculty limits â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function StepLimits({ a, set }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Q title="Daily limits for a faculty member" hint="These are never broken. Lab and drawing sessions count together; a session counts once however many periods it has.">
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr))", gap: 16 }}>
          <div><span style={lbl}>Most theory periods in a day</span><NumIn value={a.maxTheoryPerDay} onChange={v => set({ maxTheoryPerDay: v })} width={90} min={1} max={12} /></div>
          <div><span style={lbl}>Most lab sessions in a day</span><NumIn value={a.maxLabPerDay} onChange={v => set({ maxLabPerDay: v })} width={90} min={1} max={6} /></div>
          <div><span style={lbl}>Most periods in a day, lab and theory together</span><NumIn value={a.maxTotalPerDay} onChange={v => set({ maxTotalPerDay: v })} width={90} min={1} max={12} /></div>
        </div>
      </Q>
      <Q title="Back-to-back classes" hint="Can a faculty member have classes in consecutive periods?">
        <Radio checked={!!a.consecutive} onChange={() => set({ consecutive: true })}>Yes, up to <NumIn value={a.maxRun} onChange={v => set({ maxRun: v })} width={64} min={2} max={8} /> classes in a row (a lab session counts as one class)</Radio>
        <Radio checked={!a.consecutive} onChange={() => set({ consecutive: false })}>No, always a gap between two classes</Radio>
      </Q>
    </>

// â”€â”€ Step: availability â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function SlotGrid({ a, cells, onToggle, onDay }) {
  const maxP = Number(a.periodsPerDay) || 1;
  return (
    <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
      <table style={{ borderCollapse: "separate", borderSpacing: 3 }}>
        <thead><tr><th /><>{Array.from({ length: maxP }, (_, p) => <th key={p} style={{ fontSize: 11, color: P.gray, fontWeight: 700, padding: "0 2px" }}>P{p + 1}</th>)}</></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {Array.from({ length: a.days }, (_, d) => (
            <tr key={d}>
              <td><button onClick={() => onDay(d)} style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: P.blue, background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", padding: "0 8px 0 0", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{DAY_ABBR[d]}</button></td>
              {Array.from({ length: maxP }, (_, p) => p < periodsOn(a, d) ? (
                <td key={p}><button onClick={() => onToggle(d, p)} style={{ width: 34, height: 28, borderRadius: 6, border: "1.5px solid " + (cells[d + "-" + p] ? P.red : P.border), background: cells[d + "-" + p] ? P.red : "#fff", cursor: "pointer" }} aria-label={DAY_LONG[d] + " period " + (p + 1)} /></td>
              ) : <td key={p} />)}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StepAvailability({ a, set, ctx }) {
  const rows = a.availability;
  const setRow = (i, patch) => set({ availability: rows.map((r, k) => (k === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)) });
  const toggle = (i, d, p) => { const c = { ...rows[i].cells }; const k = d + "-" + p; if (c[k]) delete c[k]; else c[k] = true; setRow(i, { cells: c }); };
  const day = (i, d) => {
    const c = { ...rows[i].cells };
    const all = Array.from({ length: periodsOn(a, d) }, (_, p) => p);
    const full = all.every(p => c[d + "-" + p]);
    all.forEach(p => { if (full) delete c[d + "-" + p]; else c[d + "-" + p] = true; });
    setRow(i, { cells: c });
  };
  return (
    <Q title="Faculty who are not free at some times" hint="For someone who can't come on certain days or periods, or who is shared with another department and is here only at certain times. Pick the person, then mark the slots. Press a day's name to mark the whole day. Skip this if there is nobody like that.">
      {rows.map((r, i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{ border: "1.5px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 10, padding: "12px 14px", marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12, flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <select value={r.phone} onChange={e => setRow(i, { phone: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inp, minWidth: 240 }}>
              <option value="">Choose a faculty memberâ€¦</option>
              {ctx.people.map(p => <option key={p.phone} value={p.phone}>{p.name}</option>)}
            </select>
            <Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => set({ availability: rows.filter((_, k) => k !== i) })}>Remove</Btn>
          </div>
          <Radio checked={r.mode === "blocked"} onChange={() => setRow(i, { mode: "blocked" })}>Not available in the slots I mark (red)</Radio>
          <Radio checked={r.mode === "only"} onChange={() => setRow(i, { mode: "only" })}>Available <b>only</b> in the slots I mark (shared with another department)</Radio>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}><SlotGrid a={a} cells={r.cells || {}} onToggle={(d, p) => toggle(i, d, p)} onDay={d => day(i, d)} /></div>
        </div>
      ))}
      <Btn small variant="outline" onClick={() => set({ availability: [...rows, { phone: "", mode: "blocked", cells: {} }] })}>+ Add a faculty member</Btn>
    </Q>
  );
}

// src/timetableDesign/StepSubjects.jsx
// "Subjects and periods": how many periods a week for every subject, and for the activities that are not subjects in
// the portal (library, tutorials, sports, clubs and anything else). A live total shows, for every section, how many of
// the week's periods the numbers use. Options on each row cover a different number for one section and, for classes
// run on an outside trainer's own timetable (CRT, say), fixed days and periods.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { P, Btn } from "../components/UI";
import { newExtra, DAY_LONG, num, periodsOn } from "./designModel";
import { Q, Radio, Check, NumIn, YearWarnings, inp, small, lbl } from "./steps";

const MONO = "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";
const OTHER_PRESETS = [{ name: "Library", label: "Library" }, { name: "Tutorials", label: "Tutorials" }, { name: "Sports", label: "Sports" }, { name: "Club activities", label: "Club activities / Misc" }];
const th = { textAlign: "left", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.04em", color: P.gray, padding: "6px 10px 6px 0", borderBottom: "1.5px solid " + P.border };
const td = { padding: "8px 10px 8px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid " + P.border, verticalAlign: "middle" };

// day and period dropdowns, one row for each period of the week, for each section
function SlotsEditor({ a, sections, countOf, fixed, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {sections.map((sec, si) => {
        const count = Math.min(12, Math.max(0, Math.floor(countOf(sec.id))));
        const rows = (fixed || {})[sec.id] || [];
        const setRow = (k, patch) => { const r = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => rows[i] || { day: "", period: "" }); r[k] = { ...r[k], ...patch }; onChange({ ...(fixed || {}), [sec.id]: r }); };
        return (
          <div key={sec.id} style={{ padding: "8px 0", borderTop: si ? "1px dashed " + P.border : "none" }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, marginBottom: 4, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <b style={{ fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 13 }}>{sec.name}</b>
              <span style={small}>{count} slot{count === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span>
              {si === 0 && sections.length > 1 && count > 0 && <Btn small variant="ghost" onClick={() => { const f = { ...(fixed || {}) }; sections.forEach(o => { f[o.id] = rows.slice(0, count).map(r => ({ ...r })); }); onChange(f); }}>Use these for every section</Btn>}
            </div>
            {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, k) => {
              const r = rows[k] || { day: "", period: "" };
              return (
                <div key={k} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center", padding: "3px 0" }}>
                  <span style={{ ...small, width: 48 }}>Slot {k + 1}</span>
                  <select value={r.day} onChange={e => setRow(k, { day: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inp, width: 140 }}>
                    <option value="">Dayâ€¦</option>{Array.from({ length: a.days }, (_, d) => <option key={d} value={d}>{DAY_LONG[d]}</option>)}
                  </select>
                  <select value={r.period} onChange={e => setRow(k, { period: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inp, width: 130 }}>
                    <option value="">Periodâ€¦</option>{Array.from({ length: Number(a.periodsPerDay) || 0 }, (_, p) => <option key={p} value={p + 1}>Period {p + 1}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// one total for everything ticked, in one place. Sections that differ show a range and the detail underneath.
function TotalBar({ totals, fallback }) {
  if (!totals.length) return <div style={{ ...small, margin: "0 0 14px" }}>A week has {fallback || "?"} periods in each section. Fix the timings in Days and periods to see the totals.</div>;
  const have = totals[0].have;
  const needs = totals.map(t => t.need), lo = Math.min(...needs), hi = Math.max(...needs);
  const over = hi > have, short = lo < have;
  const badge = over ? { text: (hi - have) + " too many: reduce something", bg: P.redL, fg: P.red }
    : short ? { text: (have - lo) + " more to allot: no blank periods allowed", bg: P.amberL, fg: P.amber }
    : { text: "Every period is filled", bg: P.greenL, fg: P.green };
  return (
    <div style={{ border: "1.5px solid " + P.border, borderRadius: 10, padding: "12px 16px", margin: "0 0 16px", background: "#fff" }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 12, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, color: P.navy }}>
          Total periods covered: <span style={{ fontFamily: MONO }}>{lo === hi ? lo : lo + " to " + hi}</span> <span style={{ color: P.gray, fontWeight: 600 }}>out of {have}</span>
        </div>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, color: badge.fg, background: badge.bg, borderRadius: 20, padding: "5px 14px" }}>{badge.text}</span>
      </div>
      {lo !== hi && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: P.gray, marginTop: 6 }}>The sections you ticked differ: {totals.map(t => t.s.name + " " + t.need).join(", ")}.</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function StepSubjects({ a, set, ctx, calc }) {

  const toggle = key => setOpen({ ...open, [key]: !open[key] });

          <td style={{ ...td, fontSize: 13, color: P.gray }}>{s.type}</td>

                {(() => { const per = num(l.periods, 0), b = Math.max(1, num(l.block, 3)); if (!per) return null; if (per <= b) return <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, marginTop: 3, color: P.green, fontWeight: 600 }}>= 1 session of {per} period{per === 1 ? "" : "s"} a week</div>; const full = Math.floor(per / b), rem = per % b; return <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, marginTop: 3, color: rem ? P.amber : P.green, fontWeight: 600 }}>= {full + " session" + (full === 1 ? "" : "s") + " of " + b}{rem ? " + 1 shorter session of " + rem : ""} a week</div>; })()}

// src/timetableDesign/VersionEditor.jsx
// Minor changes to one designed version: every section's timetable as an editable grid. Click a class to move it,
// swap it with another class of the same section, or change its faculty. Each change is checked for overlaps first
// (faculty, section, other published timetables, and labs of different sections when those may not overlap); one that
// would clash is not made. Nothing is kept until "Save changes".

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { P, Btn, Card } from "../components/UI";
import { DAY_NAMES, fmtRange } from "../timetableUpload/timeUtils";
import { suggestMoves } from "../timetableUpload/overlapCheck";
import { checkEdit, loadWarnings } from "../timetableUpload/editChecks";
import { BlockPanel } from "../timetableUpload/PublishedEditor";

const MONO = "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";

export default function VersionEditor({ spec, n, blocks, others, people, colourOf, onSave, onCancel }) {
  const [work, setWork] = useState(() => blocks.map(b => ({ ...b })));
  const [log, setLog] = useState([]);
  const [secId, setSecId] = useState(spec.sections[0] ? spec.sections[0].id : "");
  const [pick, setPick] = useState(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState(null);

  const slots = spec.timings.slots;
  const section = { ...(spec.sections.find(s => s.id === secId) || spec.sections[0]), slots };
  const days = spec.D;
  const noLabOverlap = spec.a.labsOverlap === false;
  const peopleBy = new Map(people.map(p => [p.phone, p]));
  const facObj = phone => { const p = peopleBy.get(phone); return p ? { key: phone, name: p.name, phone, external: false } : null; };
  const teachIdx = start => slots.filter(s => !s.brk && s.start < start).length;     // 0-based
  const picked = pick ? work.find(b => b.id === pick) : null;

  function apply(result, ofBlock) {
    if (result.error) { setMsg({ ok: false, text: result.error }); return; }
    // a short day (a half-day Saturday) has fewer periods
    const late = result.editedIds.map(id => result.blocks.find(x => x.id === id)).find(b => b && teachIdx(b.start) + (b.periods || 1) > spec.P[b.day]);
    if (late) { setMsg({ ok: false, text: "Not changed. " + DAY_NAMES[late.day] + " has only " + spec.P[late.day] + " periods, so " + late.token + " can't go there." }); return; }
    const chk = checkEdit(result.blocks, result.editedIds, others, { noLabOverlap, year: spec.year });
    if (!chk.ok) {
      let ideas = [];
      if (ofBlock) {
        const all = work.map(b => ({ ...b, source: "upload" })).concat(others);
        ideas = suggestMoves({ ...ofBlock, source: "upload" }, slots, all).map(o => o.text).slice(0, 3);
      }
      setMsg({ ok: false, text: "Not changed. This edit would cause a clash:", problems: chk.problems.map(p => p.text), ideas });
      return;
    }
    const warnings = loadWarnings(result.blocks, result.editedIds, { maxTotal: spec.limits.maxTotal, maxTheory: spec.limits.maxTheory, maxLab: spec.limits.maxLab });
    if (spec.a.labOnceADay !== false) {
      const seen = new Set();
      result.editedIds.forEach(id => {
        const b = result.blocks.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!b || (b.type !== "lab" && b.type !== "drawing")) return;
        const sessions = new Set(result.blocks.filter(x => x.sectionId === b.sectionId && x.day === b.day && (x.type === "lab" || x.type === "drawing")).map(x => x.start + "-" + x.end));
        if (sessions.size > 1 && !seen.has(b.sectionId + b.day)) { seen.add(b.sectionId + b.day); warnings.push(b.sectionName + " now has two lab sessions on " + DAY_NAMES[b.day] + "."); }
      });
    }
    setWork(result.blocks);
    setLog(l => l.concat(result.text));
    setMsg({ ok: true, text: result.text, warnings });
    setPick(null);
  }

  return (
    <Card style={{ margin: 0, padding: "16px 18px", borderColor: P.blue }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 6 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 17 }}>Minor changes to Version {n}</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>
          <Btn variant="outline" onClick={() => (log.length && !window.confirm("Throw away the " + log.length + " change" + (log.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " you made here?") ? null : onCancel())}>Cancel</Btn>
          <Btn disabled={!log.length} onClick={() => onSave(work, log)}>Save changes{log.length ? " (" + log.length + ")" : ""}</Btn>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: P.gray, lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: 10 }}>Click a class to move it, swap it with another class of the same section, or change its faculty. Every change is checked for overlaps first, and one that would clash is not made.</div>

      {msg && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: msg.ok ? P.green : P.red, background: msg.ok ? P.greenL : P.redL, borderRadius: 10, padding: "12px 16px", marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{msg.text}</div>
          {(msg.problems || []).map((t, i) => <div key={i} style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>â€¢ {t}</div>)}
          {(msg.ideas || []).length > 0 && <div style={{ marginTop: 8, color: "#1a2230" }}><b>You could instead:</b>{msg.ideas.map((t, i) => <div key={i}>â€¢ {t}</div>)}</div>}
          {(msg.warnings || []).map((t, i) => <div key={i} style={{ marginTop: 4, color: P.amber }}>âš  {t} (allowed, but check it is what you want)</div>)}
        </div>
      )}

      {spec.sections.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 10 }}>
          {spec.sections.map(s => (
            <button key={s.id} onClick={() => { setSecId(s.id); setPick(null); }} style={{ padding: "5px 12px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", border: "1.5px solid " + (section.id === s.id ? P.blue : P.border), background: section.id === s.id ? P.blue : "#fff", color: section.id === s.id ? "#fff" : P.navy }}>{s.name}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
        <table style={{ borderCollapse: "separate", borderSpacing: 3, minWidth: 700 }}>
          <thead>
            <tr><th />{slots.map((s, i) => <th key={i} style={{ fontSize: 10.5, color: P.gray, fontWeight: 700, padding: "2px 4px", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{s.brk ? (s.label || "Break") : "P" + (slots.slice(0, i).filter(x => !x.brk).length + 1)}<div style={{ fontWeight: 400, fontFamily: MONO }}>{fmtRange(s.start, s.end)}</div></th>)}</tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {Array.from({ length: days }, (_, d) => {
              const mine = work.filter(b => b.sectionId === section.id && b.day === d);
              const cells = [];
              let i = 0;
              while (i < slots.length) {
                const s = slots[i];
                if (s.brk) { cells.push(<td key={i} style={{ background: "#f6efdc", borderRadius: 5, width: 18 }} />); i++; continue; }
                const starts = mine.filter(b => b.start === s.start);
                if (!starts.length) { cells.push(<td key={i} style={{ background: "#fafafa", border: "1px dashed " + P.border, borderRadius: 5, textAlign: "center", color: "#c3c9d0", fontSize: 12 }}>-</td>); i++; continue; }
                const end = Math.max(...starts.map(b => b.end));
                let j = i;
                while (j + 1 < slots.length && slots[j + 1].end <= end) j++;
                cells.push(
                  <td key={i} colSpan={j - i + 1}>
                    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 2 }}>
                      {starts.map(b => {
                        const [bg, fg] = colourOf(b.token);
                        const on = pick === b.id;
                        return <button key={b.id} onClick={() => { setPick(b.id); setMsg(null); }} title={b.faculty.map(f => f.name).join(", ") || "no faculty"} style={{ background: "#" + bg, color: "#" + fg, border: on ? "2.5px solid " + P.navy : "2.5px solid transparent", borderRadius: 5, padding: "6px 6px", fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", minWidth: 74 }}>{b.token}</button>;
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                );
                i = j + 1;
              }
              return <tr key={d}><td style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, paddingRight: 8 }}>{DAY_NAMES[d].slice(0, 3)}</td>{cells}</tr>;
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {picked && <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}><BlockPanel key={picked.id} b={picked} section={section} slots={slots} days={days} blocks={work} people={people} facObj={facObj} apply={apply} /></div>}
      {log.length > 0 && <details style={{ marginTop: 10 }}><summary style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: P.gray, cursor: "pointer" }}>{log.length} change{log.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} so far</summary>{log.map((t, i) => <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 12.5, padding: "2px 0" }}>â€¢ {t}</div>)}</details>}
    </Card>
  );
}

// src/timetableUpload/editChecks.js
// Edits to a published timetable (move, swap, change faculty, add, remove) and the checks that run on every one.
// Each edit function returns { blocks, editedIds, text } or { error }; checkEdit then says whether the result is
// allowed: a faculty member may not be in two places at once (including other years' published timetables) and a
// section may not have two classes at the same time (except labs running together as batches).

import { detectOverlaps } from "./overlapCheck";
import { DAY_NAMES, fmtRange } from "./timeUtils";

const day3 = d => DAY_NAMES[d].slice(0, 3);
const LABISH = ["lab", "drawing"];
const mkId = b => b.sectionId + ":" + b.day + ":" + b.start + ":" + b.token;
const teachingOf = slots => (slots || []).filter(s => !s.brk).slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);

// where a block of k periods could start (index into the section's teaching periods)
export function startOptions(block, slots) {
  const t = teachingOf(slots);
  const k = block.periods || 1;
  // a block that already runs across a break (a lab, say) may keep doing so
  const first = t.findIndex(s => s.start === block.start);
  let gapOk = false;
  if (first >= 0) for (let x = first + 1; x < first + k && x < t.length; x++) if (t[x].start !== t[x - 1].end) gapOk = true;
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + k <= t.length; i++) {
    let ok = true;
    for (let x = i + 1; x < i + k; x++) if (t[x].start !== t[x - 1].end && !gapOk) ok = false;
    if (ok) out.push({ index: i, start: t[i].start, end: t[i + k - 1].end });
  }
  return out;
}

export function moveBlock(blocks, id, day, start, slots) {
  const b = blocks.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!b) return { error: "That class could not be found." };
  const opt = startOptions(b, slots).find(o => o.start === start);
  if (!opt) return { error: "A " + (b.periods || 1) + "-period class can't start there." };
  if (b.day === day && b.start === start) return { error: "It is already there." };
  const text = "Moved " + b.token + " (" + b.sectionName + ") from " + day3(b.day) + " " + fmtRange(b.start, b.end) + " to " + day3(day) + " " + fmtRange(opt.start, opt.end) + ".";
  const moved = { ...b, day, start: opt.start, end: opt.end };
  moved.id = mkId(moved);
  return { blocks: blocks.map(x => (x.id === id ? moved : x)), editedIds: [moved.id], text };
}

export function swapBlocks(blocks, idA, idB) {
  const a = blocks.find(x => x.id === idA), b = blocks.find(x => x.id === idB);
  if (!a || !b) return { error: "A class could not be found." };
  if (a.sectionId !== b.sectionId) return { error: "Only two classes of the same section can be swapped." };
  if ((a.periods || 1) !== (b.periods || 1)) return { error: "These two classes have a different number of periods, so they can't swap places." };
  const na = { ...a, day: b.day, start: b.start, end: b.end }, nb = { ...b, day: a.day, start: a.start, end: a.end };
  na.id = mkId(na); nb.id = mkId(nb);
  return {
    blocks: blocks.map(x => (x.id === idA ? na : x.id === idB ? nb : x)), editedIds: [na.id, nb.id],
    text: "Swapped " + a.token + " (" + day3(a.day) + " " + fmtRange(a.start, a.end) + ") with " + b.token + " (" + day3(b.day) + " " + fmtRange(b.start, b.end) + ") in " + a.sectionName + ".",
  };
}

export function changeFaculty(blocks, id, faculty) {
  const b = blocks.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!b) return { error: "That class could not be found." };
  const f = faculty.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, role: i === 0 ? "main" : "asst" }));
  const before = b.faculty.map(x => x.name).join(", ") || "nobody";
  return { blocks: blocks.map(x => (x.id === id ? { ...x, faculty: f } : x)), editedIds: [id], text: "Changed the faculty of " + b.token + " (" + b.sectionName + ", " + day3(b.day) + " " + fmtRange(b.start, b.end) + ") from " + before + " to " + (f.map(x => x.name).join(", ") || "nobody") + "." };
}

export function removeBlock(blocks, id) {
  const b = blocks.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!b) return { error: "That class could not be found." };
  return { blocks: blocks.filter(x => x.id !== id), editedIds: [], text: "Removed " + b.token + " (" + b.sectionName + ", " + day3(b.day) + " " + fmtRange(b.start, b.end) + ")." };
}

// section: { id, name, slots }; item: { token, subject, type, faculty, periods }
export function addBlock(blocks, section, day, start, item) {
  const probe = { id: "", sectionId: section.id, sectionName: section.name, day, start, end: start, token: item.token, subject: item.subject || item.token, type: item.type || "other", combo: "", periods: item.periods || 1, faculty: item.faculty || [] };
  const opt = startOptions(probe, section.slots).find(o => o.start === start);
  if (!opt) return { error: "A " + probe.periods + "-period class can't start there: it would run past the day or across a break." };
  const nb = { ...probe, end: opt.end };
  nb.id = mkId(nb);
  if (blocks.some(x => x.id === nb.id)) return { error: "That class is already there." };
  return { blocks: blocks.concat(nb), editedIds: [nb.id], text: "Added " + nb.token + " to " + section.name + " on " + day3(day) + " " + fmtRange(nb.start, nb.end) + "." };
}

// is the changed timetable allowed? published = blocks of OTHER years' published timetables
// opts.noLabOverlap: labs of different sections may not be at the same time
export function checkEdit(blocks, editedIds, published, opts = {}) {
  const tagged = blocks.map(b => ({ ...b, source: "upload" }));
  const facultyClashes = detectOverlaps(tagged, published)
    .filter(c => editedIds.includes(c.a.id) || editedIds.includes(c.b.id))
    .map(c => ({
      text: c.name + " would be in two places on " + DAY_NAMES[c.day] + ": " + c.a.sectionName + " Â· " + c.a.token + " (" + fmtRange(c.a.start, c.a.end) + ") and " + c.b.sectionName + " Â· " + c.b.token + " (" + fmtRange(c.b.start, c.b.end) + ")" +
        (c.b.source === "published" ? ", which is already published for Year " + (c.b.publishedYear || "?") : "") + ".",
    }));
  const sectionClashes = [];
  editedIds.forEach(id => {
    const b = blocks.find(x => x.id === id);
    if (!b) return;
    const o = blocks.find(x => x.id !== id && x.sectionId === b.sectionId && x.day === b.day && x.start < b.end && b.start < x.end
      && !(x.start === b.start && x.end === b.end && LABISH.includes(x.type) && LABISH.includes(b.type)));
    if (o) sectionClashes.push({ text: b.sectionName + " would have two classes at once on " + DAY_NAMES[b.day] + ": " + b.token + " and " + o.token + " (" + fmtRange(Math.max(b.start, o.start), Math.min(b.end, o.end)) + ")." });
  });
  const labClashes = [];
  if (opts.noLabOverlap) {
    editedIds.forEach(id => {
      const b = blocks.find(x => x.id === id);
      if (!b || !LABISH.includes(b.type)) return;
      const o = blocks.find(x => x.id !== id && x.sectionId !== b.sectionId && LABISH.includes(x.type) && x.day === b.day && x.start < b.end && b.start < x.end && !(x.combo && x.combo === b.combo))
        || (published || []).find(x => LABISH.includes(x.type) && x.day === b.day && x.start < b.end && b.start < x.end && (!opts.year || !x.publishedYear || x.publishedYear === opts.year));
      if (o) labClashes.push({ text: "You chose that labs of different sections may not overlap, but " + b.sectionName + " " + b.token + " would be at the same time as " + o.sectionName + " " + o.token + " on " + DAY_NAMES[b.day] + "." });
    });
  }
  const problems = facultyClashes.concat(sectionClashes, labClashes);
  return { ok: problems.length === 0, problems };
}

// not a rule, a heads-up: a faculty member now has more than the usual in a day
export function loadWarnings(blocks, editedIds, limits = { maxTotal: 4, maxTheory: 3, maxLab: 1 }) {
  const keys = new Set();
  blocks.filter(b => editedIds.includes(b.id)).forEach(b => b.faculty.forEach(f => { if (!f.external) keys.add(f.key); }));
  const per = new Map();
  const counted = new Set();
  blocks.forEach(b => {
    if (b.type === "other" || b.type === "note") return;
    b.faculty.forEach(f => {
      if (!keys.has(f.key)) return;
      if (b.combo) { const id = f.key + "|" + b.day + "|" + b.start + "|" + b.combo; if (counted.has(id)) return; counted.add(id); }
      const k = f.key + "|" + b.day;
      const r = per.get(k) || { name: f.name, day: b.day, tot: 0, th: 0, lab: 0 };
      r.tot += b.periods; if (b.type === "theory") r.th += b.periods; else r.lab += 1;
      per.set(k, r);
    });
  });
  const out = [];
  per.forEach(r => {
    if (r.tot > limits.maxTotal) out.push(r.name + " now has " + r.tot + " periods on " + DAY_NAMES[r.day] + ".");
    else if (r.th > limits.maxTheory) out.push(r.name + " now has " + r.th + " theory periods on " + DAY_NAMES[r.day] + ".");
    else if (r.lab > limits.maxLab) out.push(r.name + " now has " + r.lab + " lab sessions on " + DAY_NAMES[r.day] + ".");
  });
  return out;
}

// src/timetableUpload/overlapCheck.js
// Works on "blocks": runs of back-to-back periods with the same class in one section on one day.
//   block = { id, sectionId, sectionName, day, start, end, token, subject, type, faculty, combo, periods, source }
// A faculty member is double-booked when two of their blocks overlap in real clock time on the same day,
// unless the two blocks carry the same clubbed-class code (C1, C2 ...) in different sections.

import { DAY_NAMES, fmtRange } from "./timeUtils";

export function groupBlocks(entries, source) {
  const sorted = entries.slice().sort((a, b) =>
    a.sectionId.localeCompare(b.sectionId) || a.day - b.day || a.token.localeCompare(b.token) || a.start - b.start);
  const blocks = [];
  sorted.forEach(e => {
    const last = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
    const sameFaculty = last && last.faculty.map(f => f.key).join("|") === e.faculty.map(f => f.key).join("|");
    if (last && last.sectionId === e.sectionId && last.day === e.day && last.token === e.token && last.combo === e.combo && sameFaculty && e.start <= last.end) {
      last.end = Math.max(last.end, e.end);
      last.periods += 1;
      return;
    }
    blocks.push({
      id: e.sectionId + ":" + e.day + ":" + e.start + ":" + e.token,
      sectionId: e.sectionId, sectionName: e.sectionName, day: e.day, start: e.start, end: e.end,
      token: e.token, subject: e.subject, type: e.type, faculty: e.faculty, combo: e.combo, periods: 1, source,
    });
  });
  return blocks;
}

const clash = (a, b) => a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end;
const exempt = (a, b) => !!a.combo && a.combo === b.combo && a.sectionId !== b.sectionId;
const label = b => b.sectionName + " Â· " + DAY_NAMES[b.day].slice(0, 3) + " " + fmtRange(b.start, b.end) + " Â· " + b.token;

// All blocks of every faculty member, with the upload's blocks tagged so only clashes that involve them are reported.
export function detectOverlaps(uploadBlocks, publishedBlocks) {
  const all = uploadBlocks.map(b => ({ ...b, source: "upload" })).concat(publishedBlocks.map(b => ({ ...b, source: "published" })));
  const byFaculty = new Map();
  all.forEach(b => b.faculty.forEach(f => {
    if (!byFaculty.has(f.key)) byFaculty.set(f.key, { name: f.name, blocks: [] });
    byFaculty.get(f.key).blocks.push(b);
  }));
  const conflicts = [], seen = new Set();
  byFaculty.forEach((v, key) => {
    const list = v.blocks.slice().sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day || a.start - b.start);
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < list.length; j++) {
        const a = list[i], b = list[j];
        if (a.day !== b.day) break;
        if (b.start >= a.end) break;
        if (a.source === "published" && b.source === "published") continue;
        if (!clash(a, b) || exempt(a, b)) continue;
        const id = key + "|" + [a.id + a.source, b.id + b.source].sort().join("|");
        if (seen.has(id)) continue;
        seen.add(id);
        conflicts.push({ key, name: v.name, day: a.day, a, b });
      }
    }
  });
  return conflicts.sort((x, y) => x.name.localeCompare(y.name) || x.day - y.day || x.a.start - y.a.start);
}

// Clubbed-class markers must pair up: the same code in 2+ sections, at the same time.
export function checkCombos(uploadBlocks) {
  const problems = [];
  const byCode = new Map();
  uploadBlocks.filter(b => b.combo).forEach(b => { if (!byCode.has(b.combo)) byCode.set(b.combo, []); byCode.get(b.combo).push(b); });
  byCode.forEach((list, code) => {
    const sections = new Set(list.map(b => b.sectionId));
    if (sections.size < 2) {
      problems.push({ level: "warn", text: "Clubbed marker (" + code + ") is used in only one section (" + list[0].sectionName + "). Use the same code in every section that is joined." });
      return;
    }
    list.forEach(b => {
      const mate = list.some(o => o.sectionId !== b.sectionId && o.day === b.day && clash(o, b));
      if (!mate) problems.push({ level: "warn", text: "Clubbed marker (" + code + ") in " + label(b) + " has no matching class at the same time in another section." });
    });
  });
  return problems;
}

// â”€â”€ Suggestions â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function freeFor(blocks, faculty, day, start, end, ignoreIds, combo, sectionId) {
  return faculty.every(f => !blocks.some(o =>
    !ignoreIds.includes(o.id + o.source) && o.day === day && o.start < end && start < o.end &&
    o.faculty.some(x => x.key === f.key) && !(combo && o.combo === combo && o.sectionId !== sectionId)));
}

// Up to three conflict-free places to move `block`, then up to two swaps, all inside the same section.
export function suggestMoves(block, sectionSlots, allBlocks) {
  if (block.combo) return [{ text: "This is a clubbed class (" + block.combo + "). Change it in every joined section together, then upload again." }];
  const teaching = sectionSlots.filter(s => !s.brk).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  const secBlocks = allBlocks.filter(b => b.sectionId === block.sectionId && b.source === "upload");
  const k = block.periods;
  const selfId = block.id + block.source;

  // which teaching slot indexes does a block of this section occupy?
  const occupied = (d, i) => secBlocks.some(b => b.id + b.source !== selfId && b.day === d && b.start <= teaching[i].start && teaching[i].end <= b.end);
  const runOk = (i) => { for (let x = i; x < i + k; x++) { if (!teaching[x]) return false; if (x > i && teaching[x].start !== teaching[x - 1].end) return false; } return true; };

  const moves = [];
  for (let d = 0; d < DAY_NAMES.length; d++) {
    for (let i = 0; i + k <= teaching.length; i++) {
      if (!runOk(i)) continue;
      const start = teaching[i].start, end = teaching[i + k - 1].end;
      if (d === block.day && start === block.start) continue;
      let free = true;
      for (let x = i; x < i + k; x++) if (occupied(d, x)) free = false;
      if (!free) continue;
      if (!freeFor(allBlocks, block.faculty, d, start, end, [selfId], block.combo, block.sectionId)) continue;
      moves.push({ d, start, end, score: (d === block.day ? 0 : 1000) + Math.abs(start - block.start) });
    }
  }
  moves.sort((x, y) => x.score - y.score);
  const out = moves.slice(0, 3).map(m => ({
    text: "Move " + block.token + " from " + DAY_NAMES[block.day].slice(0, 3) + " " + fmtRange(block.start, block.end) + " to " + DAY_NAMES[m.d].slice(0, 3) + " " + fmtRange(m.start, m.end) +
      " â€” " + (block.faculty.length ? block.faculty.map(f => f.name).join(", ") + " and the section are free then." : "the section is free then."),
    move: { d: m.d, start: m.start, end: m.end },
  }));

  if (out.length === 0) {
    secBlocks.filter(o => o.id !== block.id && o.periods === k && !o.combo).some(o => {
      const ignore = [selfId, o.id + o.source];
      const xOk = freeFor(allBlocks, block.faculty, o.day, o.start, o.end, ignore, block.combo, block.sectionId);
      const yOk = freeFor(allBlocks, o.faculty, block.day, block.start, block.end, ignore, o.combo, o.sectionId);
      if (xOk && yOk) out.push({ text: "Swap " + block.token + " (" + DAY_NAMES[block.day].slice(0, 3) + " " + fmtRange(block.start, block.end) + ") with " + o.token + " (" + DAY_NAMES[o.day].slice(0, 3) + " " + fmtRange(o.start, o.end) + ") â€” both faculty are free at the new times.", swap: { otherId: o.id } });
      return out.length >= 2;
    });
  }
  if (out.length === 0) out.push({ text: "No free slot in this section suits all the faculty. Try changing the other section's class, or the faculty." });
  return out;
}

// One suggestion list per conflict: the upload's own side is moved; if both sides are in the upload, either can move.
export function suggestionsFor(conflict, slotsBySection, allBlocks) {
  const movable = [conflict.a, conflict.b].filter(b => b.source === "upload");
  return movable.map(b => ({ block: b, options: suggestMoves(b, slotsBySection[b.sectionId] || [], allBlocks) }));
}

// â”€â”€ Workload â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
export function computeWorkload(blocks) {
  const rows = new Map();
  const counted = new Set();
  blocks.forEach(b => {
    if (b.type === "note") return;
    b.faculty.forEach(f => {
      if (b.combo) { const id = f.key + "|" + b.day + "|" + b.start + "|" + b.combo; if (counted.has(id)) return; counted.add(id); }
      if (!rows.has(f.key)) rows.set(f.key, { key: f.key, name: f.name, phone: f.phone, external: f.external, theory: 0, lab: 0, drawing: 0, other: 0, asst: 0, perDay: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] });
      const r = rows.get(f.key);
      r[b.type] = (r[b.type] || 0) + b.periods;
      r.perDay[b.day] += b.periods;
      if (f.role === "asst") r.asst += b.periods;
    });
  });
  return Array.from(rows.values()).map(r => ({ ...r, teaching: r.theory + r.lab + r.drawing, overall: r.theory + r.lab + r.drawing + r.other }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

// â”€â”€ Fix it for me â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Clears overlaps by moving (or swapping) classes of the upload, one clash at a time, always to a place where the
// faculty and the section are free. Published timetables of other years are never touched.
const dayShort = d => DAY_NAMES[d].slice(0, 3);
export function autoFix(blocks, slotsBySection, publishedBlocks, maxRounds = 120) {
  const cur = blocks.map(b => ({ ...b }));
  const changes = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const reid = b => { b.id = b.sectionId + ":" + b.day + ":" + b.start + ":" + b.token; };
  for (let round = 0; round < maxRounds; round++) {
    const conflicts = detectOverlaps(cur, publishedBlocks);
    if (!conflicts.length) break;
    const state = cur.map(b => b.id).sort().join("|");
    if (seen.has(state)) break;
    seen.add(state);
    let fixed = false;
    for (const c of conflicts) {
      for (const cand of [c.a, c.b]) {
        if (cand.source !== "upload" || cand.combo) continue;
        const real = cur.find(b => b.id === cand.id);
        if (!real) continue;
        const all = cur.map(b => ({ ...b, source: "upload" })).concat(publishedBlocks.map(b => ({ ...b, source: "published" })));
        const opts = suggestMoves({ ...real, source: "upload" }, slotsBySection[real.sectionId] || [], all);
        const mv = opts.find(o => o.move);
        const sw = opts.find(o => o.swap);
        const who = real.faculty.map(f => f.name).join(", ");
        if (mv) {
          changes.push("Moved " + real.token + " (" + real.sectionName + ") from " + dayShort(real.day) + " " + fmtRange(real.start, real.end) + " to " + dayShort(mv.move.d) + " " + fmtRange(mv.move.start, mv.move.end) + (who ? " â€” " + who + " was double-booked." : "."));
          real.day = mv.move.d; real.start = mv.move.start; real.end = mv.move.end; reid(real);
          fixed = true;
        } else if (sw) {
          const other = cur.find(b => b.id === sw.swap.otherId);
          if (other) {
            changes.push("Swapped " + real.token + " (" + dayShort(real.day) + " " + fmtRange(real.start, real.end) + ") with " + other.token + " (" + dayShort(other.day) + " " + fmtRange(other.start, other.end) + ") in " + real.sectionName + ".");
            const t = { day: real.day, start: real.start, end: real.end };
            real.day = other.day; real.start = other.start; real.end = other.end;
            other.day = t.day; other.start = t.start; other.end = t.end;
            reid(real); reid(other);
            fixed = true;
          }
        }
        if (fixed) break;
      }
      if (fixed) break;
    }
    if (!fixed) break;
  }
  return { blocks: cur, changes, remaining: detectOverlaps(cur, publishedBlocks) };
}

export function BlockPanel({ b, section, slots, days, blocks, people, facObj, apply, remove }) {

      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.gray, marginBottom: 12 }}>{b.faculty.map(f => f.name).join(", ") || "No faculty"}</div>

            <select value={day} onChange={e => setDay(Number(e.target.value))} style={sel}>{Array.from({ length: days }, (_, d) => <option key={d} value={d}>{DAY_NAMES[d]}</option>)}</select>
            <select value={start} onChange={e => setStart(Number(e.target.value))} style={sel}>{opts.map(o => <option key={o.start} value={o.start}>Period {teachingIdx(o.start)} Â· {fmtRange(o.start, o.end)}</option>)}</select>

          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style={lbl}>Swap with another class of {section.name}</span>
          {swapWith.length === 0 ? <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: P.gray }}>No other class of the same length.</div> : (
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <select value={swapId} onChange={e => setSwapId(e.target.value)} style={{ ...sel, maxWidth: 260 }}>
                <option value="">Chooseâ€¦</option>
                {swapWith.slice().sort((x, y) => x.day - y.day || x.start - y.start).map(x => <option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{DAY_NAMES[x.day].slice(0, 3)} {fmtRange(x.start, x.end)} Â· {x.token}</option>)}
              </select>
              <Btn small disabled={!swapId} onClick={() => apply(swapBlocks(blocks, b.id, swapId), b)}>Swap</Btn>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <span style={lbl}>Faculty</span>
        <FacultyListEditor list={list} onChange={setList} facultyOptions={opt} />
        {external.length > 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: P.gray, marginTop: 6 }}>From outside the portal, kept as they are: {external.map(f => f.name).join(", ")}.</div>}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}><Btn small variant="outline" onClick={() => apply(changeFaculty(blocks, b.id, list.filter(Boolean).map(facObj).filter(Boolean).concat(external)), b)}>Change faculty</Btn></div>
      </div>
      {remove && <div style={{ marginTop: 14, borderTop: "1px solid " + P.border, paddingTop: 12 }}><Btn small variant="danger" onClick={remove}>Remove this class</Btn></div>}
    </Card>
  );
}

// src/timetableUpload/publishMaster.js
// Saves a year's timetable as the master timetable (masterTimetables/{year}). Used when an uploaded sheet is published,
// when a designed version is published, and when a published timetable is edited on screen.

import { doc, setDoc, deleteDoc } from "firebase/firestore";
import { db } from "../firebase";

export function masterData({ year, blocks, sections, user, fileName = "", keepFrom = null, edited = false }) {
  const keep = b => ({
    id: b.id, sectionId: b.sectionId, sectionName: b.sectionName, day: b.day, start: b.start, end: b.end,
    token: b.token, subject: b.subject, type: b.type, combo: b.combo || "", periods: b.periods,
    faculty: b.faculty.map(f => ({ key: f.key, name: f.name, phone: f.phone || null, external: !!f.external, role: f.role })),
  });
  const base = {
    year,
    blocks: blocks.map(keep),
    sections: sections.map(sec => ({ id: sec.id, name: sec.name, slots: sec.slots.map(x => ({ start: x.start, end: x.end, brk: !!x.brk, ...(x.label ? { label: x.label } : {}) })) })),
    publishedBy: user.phone, publishedByName: user.name || user.phone, publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    fileName,
  };
  if (edited && keepFrom) {
    base.publishedBy = keepFrom.publishedBy || user.phone;
    base.publishedByName = keepFrom.publishedByName || user.name || user.phone;
    base.publishedAt = keepFrom.publishedAt || base.publishedAt;
    base.fileName = keepFrom.fileName || "";
    base.lastEditedBy = user.phone; base.lastEditedByName = user.name || user.phone; base.lastEditedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  }
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(base));
}

export async function publishMaster(args) {
  const data = masterData(args);
  if (JSON.stringify(data).length > 900000) throw new Error("this timetable is too large to store in one piece");
  await setDoc(doc(db, "masterTimetables", args.year), data);
  return data;
}

// Publishing some sections of a year keeps the year's other sections as they are: the sections given replace their
// own classes and timings, everything else in the existing year is carried over.
export function mergeSections(existing, blocks, sections) {
  if (!existing) return { blocks, sections };
  const ids = new Set(sections.map(x => x.id));
  return {
    blocks: (existing.blocks || []).filter(b => !ids.has(b.sectionId)).concat(blocks),
    sections: (existing.sections || []).filter(x => !ids.has(x.id)).concat(sections),
  };
}

// Takes some sections out of a published year. If none are left, the year's timetable is withdrawn altogether.
export async function removeSections({ year, existing, sectionIds, user }) {
  const ids = new Set(sectionIds);
  const blocks = (existing.blocks || []).filter(b => !ids.has(b.sectionId));
  const sections = (existing.sections || []).filter(x => !ids.has(x.id));
  if (sections.length === 0) { await deleteDoc(doc(db, "masterTimetables", year)); return null; }
  return publishMaster({ year, blocks, sections, user, edited: true, keepFrom: existing });
}

// src/timetableUpload/reportBuilder.js
// Adds the generated sheets to the coordinator's own workbook so one file carries everything:
//   Sheet-3   every faculty member's individual timetable (green grids, colour-coded by subject)
//   Sheet-3B  every section's timetable (blue grids, vertical Break / Lunch columns, colour-coded by subject)
//   Sheet-4   overlaps with the suggested changes
//   Workload Summary  teaching, other duties and overall per faculty
// Written with xlsx-js-style (same file format as xlsx, but it can also write colours, borders and merged cells).

import * as XLSX from "xlsx-js-style";
import { DAY_NAMES, DAY_SHORT, fmtRange, fmtRange24 } from "./timeUtils";

export const SHEET3 = "Sheet-3 Individual";
export const SHEET3B = "Sheet-3B Sections";
export const SHEET4 = "Sheet-4 Overlaps";
export const SHEET5 = "Workload Summary";

// One soft background + one dark text colour per subject.
const PALETTE = [
  ["DDEBF7", "1F4E79"], ["E2F0D9", "375623"], ["FFF2CC", "7F6000"], ["FCE4D6", "843C0C"],
  ["E4DFEC", "4B2E83"], ["D9F2F0", "0F5F5A"], ["F8E1F4", "8A2B7E"], ["FDE2E4", "9B2C3B"],
  ["DCE6F9", "2B4C9B"], ["F3E5C8", "6B4E16"], ["D5EFD9", "1B6B3A"], ["F9D9C2", "8F3A0B"],
  ["E8E4F8", "40358C"], ["FFE0B2", "8A4B00"], ["D6EAF8", "154360"], ["EAD9E8", "6C3461"],
];
const NAVY = "16324F", BLUE = "2C5C94", GREEN = "1E5E3A", ZEBRA = "F3F6F4", WHITE = "FFFFFF", GREY_TXT = "7A8794";

const thin = { style: "thin", color: { rgb: "B8C2CC" } };
const BORDER = { top: thin, bottom: thin, left: thin, right: thin };

function st({ bg, fg = "1A2230", bold = false, size = 10, h = "center", v = "center", wrap = true, rot, border = true, italic = false } = {}) {
  const s = { font: { name: "Calibri", sz: size, bold, italic, color: { rgb: fg } }, alignment: { horizontal: h, vertical: v, wrapText: wrap } };
  if (bg) s.fill = { patternType: "solid", fgColor: { rgb: bg } };
  if (rot != null) s.alignment.textRotation = rot;
  if (border) s.border = BORDER;
  return s;
}

// A small sheet builder: set cells, merge ranges (every cell of a merge keeps the style so borders show), emit a worksheet.
class Grid {
  constructor() { this.cells = new Map(); this.merges = []; this.cols = []; this.rows = []; this.maxR = 0; this.maxC = 0; }
  set(r, c, v, s) { this.cells.set(r + ":" + c, { v, s }); this.maxR = Math.max(this.maxR, r); this.maxC = Math.max(this.maxC, c); }
  merge(r1, c1, r2, c2, v, s) {
    for (let r = r1; r <= r2; r++) for (let c = c1; c <= c2; c++) this.set(r, c, r === r1 && c === c1 ? v : "", s);
    if (r1 !== r2 || c1 !== c2) this.merges.push({ s: { r: r1, c: c1 }, e: { r: r2, c: c2 } });
  }
  sheet() {
    const ws = {};
    this.cells.forEach(({ v, s }, key) => {
      const [r, c] = key.split(":").map(Number);
      const isNum = typeof v === "number";
      ws[XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r, c })] = { v: v == null ? "" : v, t: isNum ? "n" : "s", s };
    });
    ws["!ref"] = XLSX.utils.encode_range({ s: { r: 0, c: 0 }, e: { r: this.maxR, c: this.maxC } });
    if (this.merges.length) ws["!merges"] = this.merges;
    ws["!cols"] = this.cols;
    ws["!rows"] = this.rows;
    return ws;
  }
}

export function subjectColours(blocks) {
  const map = new Map();
  Array.from(new Set(blocks.map(b => b.token))).sort().forEach((t, i) => map.set(t, PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length]));
  return t => map.get(t) || PALETTE[0];
}

const namesOf = b => b.faculty.map(f => f.name).join(" / ").toUpperCase();

// Groups blocks starting together on one day (parallel labs share a cell) and gives each group the columns it spans.
function placeBlocks(list, cols) {
  const groups = new Map();
  list.forEach(b => {
    const key = b.day + ":" + b.start;
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, { day: b.day, start: b.start, end: b.end, blocks: [] });
    const g = groups.get(key);
    g.end = Math.max(g.end, b.end);
    g.blocks.push(b);
  });
  const placed = [];
  groups.forEach(g => {
    const idx = cols.map((c, i) => (c.start < g.end && c.end > g.start ? i : -1)).filter(i => i >= 0);
    if (idx.length) placed.push({ ...g, c1: idx[0], c2: idx[idx.length - 1] });
  });
  return placed;
}

// Every distinct period and break across the sections, in time order (breaks are columns too).
function globalSlots(sections) {
  const cols = [];
  sections.forEach(s => s.slots.forEach(x => {
    if (!cols.some(c => c.start === x.start && c.end === x.end && !!c.brk === !!x.brk)) cols.push({ start: x.start, end: x.end, brk: !!x.brk, label: x.label });
  }));
  return cols.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.end - b.end);
}
const breakName = x => x.label || (x.start >= 690 ? "Lunch" : "Break");

// â”€â”€ Sheet-3: one green grid per faculty member â”€â”€
// name in the middle of the top row, total workload in its right-hand corner, break and lunch as tall vertical columns
export function facultySheet(blocks, workload, sections, colourOf, days = 6) {
  const g = new Grid();
  const slots = globalSlots(sections);
  const n = Math.max(slots.length, 1);                       // columns after the Day column
  const teach = slots.map((x, i) => ({ ...x, i })).filter(x => !x.brk);
  g.cols = [{ wch: 14 }, ...slots.map(x => ({ wch: x.brk ? 7 : 22 }))];
  if (!slots.length) g.cols = [{ wch: 14 }, { wch: 22 }];
  let r = 0;
  workload.forEach(w => {
    const mine = blocks.filter(b => b.type !== "note" && b.faculty.some(f => f.key === w.key));
    // top row: [blank] [ NAME, centred ] [ total workload ]
    const headStyle = h => st({ bg: GREEN, fg: WHITE, bold: true, size: 12, h });
    const rightFrom = n >= 5 ? n - 1 : n;                    // the last columns hold the workload
    const nameTo = n >= 5 ? rightFrom - 1 : n - 1;
    g.set(r, 0, "", headStyle("left"));
    if (nameTo >= 1) g.merge(r, 1, r, nameTo, w.name.toUpperCase() + (w.external ? "  (outside the portal)" : ""), headStyle("center"));
    else g.set(r, 1, w.name.toUpperCase(), headStyle("center"));
    if (rightFrom > nameTo) g.merge(r, rightFrom, r, n, "Total load: " + w.overall + " periods", headStyle("right"));
    g.rows[r] = { hpt: 26 };
    r++;
    g.set(r, 0, "Day", st({ bg: "2E7D4F", fg: WHITE, bold: true }));
    let period = 0;
    slots.forEach((x, i) => {
      if (x.brk) g.set(r, i + 1, breakName(x), st({ bg: "8A6D1D", fg: WHITE, bold: true, size: 9 }));
      else { period++; g.set(r, i + 1, "P" + period + " (" + fmtRange24(x.start, x.end) + ")", st({ bg: "2E7D4F", fg: WHITE, bold: true })); }
    });
    g.rows[r] = { hpt: 32 };
    r++;
    const first = r;
    slots.forEach((x, i) => {
      if (x.brk) g.merge(first, i + 1, first + days - 1, i + 1, breakName(x).toUpperCase().split("").join(" "), st({ bg: "F1E6C4", fg: "6B4E16", bold: true, size: 11, rot: 90 }));
    });
    const cols = teach.map(x => ({ start: x.start, end: x.end }));
    DAY_NAMES.slice(0, days).forEach((dn, d) => {
      const zebra = d % 2 === 1 ? ZEBRA : WHITE;
      g.set(r, 0, dn, st({ bg: "E3EFE7", bold: true, h: "left" }));
      const taken = new Set();
      placeBlocks(mine.filter(b => b.day === d), cols).forEach(pl => {
        const from = teach[pl.c1].i, to = teach[pl.c2].i;
        const [bg, fg] = colourOf(pl.blocks[0].token);
        const text = pl.blocks.map(b => {
          const me = b.faculty.find(f => f.key === w.key);
          return b.token + (me && me.role === "asst" ? " (Asst. Faculty)" : "") + "\n" + b.sectionName + (b.combo ? " (" + b.combo + ")" : "");
        }).join("\n");
        // a class that runs across a break is shown in two parts, one each side of the break column
        let segStart = null;
        for (let c = from; c <= to + 1; c++) {
          const usable = c <= to && !slots[c].brk && !taken.has(c);
          if (usable && segStart === null) segStart = c;
          if (!usable && segStart !== null) {
            for (let k = segStart; k < c; k++) taken.add(k);
            g.merge(r, segStart + 1, r, c, text, st({ bg, fg, bold: true }));
            segStart = null;
          }
        }
      });
      slots.forEach((x, c) => { if (!x.brk && !taken.has(c)) g.set(r, c + 1, "-", st({ bg: zebra, fg: GREY_TXT })); });
      g.rows[r] = { hpt: 40 };
      r++;
    });
    r++;
  });
  if (workload.length === 0) g.set(0, 0, "No faculty found in the timetable.", st({ border: false, h: "left" }));
  return g.sheet();
}

// â”€â”€ Sheet-3B: one blue grid per section â”€â”€
// opts.batchStyle writes labs that run together as "B1-TL, B2-ML" so the upload reads them back with the portal's own faculty
export function sectionSheet(blocks, sections, colourOf, days = 6, opts = {}) {
  const g = new Grid();
  const widest = Math.max(1, ...sections.map(s => s.slots.length));
  g.cols = [{ wch: 13 }, ...Array.from({ length: widest }, () => ({ wch: 20 }))];
  let r = 0;
  sections.forEach(sec => {
    const n = sec.slots.length;
    if (n === 0) return;
    g.merge(r, 0, r, n, "SECTION: " + sec.name.toUpperCase(), st({ bg: NAVY, fg: WHITE, bold: true, size: 13, h: "left" }));
    g.rows[r] = { hpt: 26 };
    r++;
    g.set(r, 0, "Day", st({ bg: BLUE, fg: WHITE, bold: true }));
    let period = 0;
    sec.slots.forEach((s, i) => {
      if (s.brk) g.set(r, i + 1, s.label || (s.start >= 690 ? "Lunch" : "Break"), st({ bg: "8A6D1D", fg: WHITE, bold: true }));
      else { period++; g.set(r, i + 1, "Period " + period + "\n" + fmtRange24(s.start, s.end), st({ bg: BLUE, fg: WHITE, bold: true })); }
    });
    g.rows[r] = { hpt: 32 };
    r++;
    const first = r;
    // break / lunch columns run down every day as one vertical block
    sec.slots.forEach((s, i) => {
      if (s.brk) g.merge(first, i + 1, first + days - 1, i + 1, (s.label || (s.start >= 690 ? "Lunch" : "Break")).toUpperCase().split("").join(" "), st({ bg: "F1E6C4", fg: "6B4E16", bold: true, size: 11, rot: 90 }));
    });
    const dataCols = sec.slots.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, i })).filter(s => !s.brk);
    const secBlocks = blocks.filter(b => b.sectionId === sec.id);
    DAY_NAMES.slice(0, days).forEach((dn, d) => {
      g.set(r, 0, dn, st({ bg: "DCE6F2", bold: true, h: "left" }));
      const taken = new Set();
      const colsForPlace = dataCols.map(s => ({ start: s.start, end: s.end }));
      placeBlocks(secBlocks.filter(b => b.day === d), colsForPlace).forEach(p => {
        const from = dataCols[p.c1].i, to = dataCols[p.c2].i;
        // a block never swallows a neighbour: stop at the first column already used
        let end = to;
        for (let c = from; c <= to; c++) if (taken.has(c)) { end = c - 1; break; }
        if (end < from) return;
        for (let c = from; c <= end; c++) taken.add(c);
        const [bg, fg] = colourOf(p.blocks[0].token);
        const text = p.blocks.length > 1 && opts.batchStyle ? p.blocks.map((b, i) => "B" + (i + 1) + "-" + b.token).join(", ") : p.blocks.map(b => {
          const who = namesOf(b);
          return b.token + (b.combo ? " (" + b.combo + ")" : "") + (who ? "\n(" + who + ")" : "");
        }).join("\n");
        g.merge(r, from + 1, r, end + 1, text, st({ bg, fg, bold: true }));
      });
      dataCols.forEach(s => { if (!taken.has(s.i)) g.set(r, s.i + 1, "-", st({ bg: d % 2 ? ZEBRA : WHITE, fg: GREY_TXT })); });
      g.rows[r] = { hpt: 54 };
      r++;
    });
    r += 2;
  });
  if (r === 0) g.set(0, 0, "No sections found.", st({ border: false, h: "left" }));
  return g.sheet();
}

// A plain table with a coloured header, borders and zebra rows (used for Sheet-4 and the summary).
function tableSheet(head, rows, widths, { numFrom = -1, headBg = NAVY, rowStyle } = {}) {
  const g = new Grid();
  g.cols = widths.map(w => ({ wch: w }));
  head.forEach((h, c) => g.set(0, c, h, st({ bg: headBg, fg: WHITE, bold: true })));
  g.rows[0] = { hpt: 30 };
  rows.forEach((row, i) => {
    const extra = rowStyle ? rowStyle(row, i) : null;
    const base = (i % 2 ? ZEBRA : WHITE);
    row.forEach((v, c) => {
      const num = numFrom >= 0 && c >= numFrom;
      g.set(i + 1, c, v, st({ bg: (extra && extra.bg) || base, h: num || c === 0 ? "center" : "left", wrap: true, bold: !!(extra && extra.boldCols && extra.boldCols.includes(c)) }));
    });
    const lines = Math.max(1, ...row.map((v, c) => String(v == null ? "" : v).split("\n").reduce((a, ln) => a + Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ln.length / (widths[c] * 1.05))), 0)));
    g.rows[i + 1] = { hpt: Math.min(300, 16 * lines + 6) };
  });
  return g.sheet();
}

export function addReportSheets(wb, { blocks, conflicts, suggestions, workload, publishedLabel, sections = [] }) {
  const colourOf = subjectColours(blocks);
  const ws3 = facultySheet(blocks, workload, sections, colourOf);
  const ws3b = sectionSheet(blocks, sections, colourOf);

  const s4 = [];
  conflicts.forEach((c, i) => {
    const sug = suggestions[i] || [];
    const lines = [];
    sug.forEach(s => s.options.forEach(o => lines.push("â€¢ " + (sug.length > 1 ? "(" + s.block.sectionName + " " + s.block.token + ") " : "") + o.text)));
    s4.push([
      i + 1, c.name, DAY_NAMES[c.day],
      c.a.sectionName + " Â· " + c.a.token, fmtRange(c.a.start, c.a.end),
      c.b.sectionName + " Â· " + c.b.token, fmtRange(c.b.start, c.b.end),
      c.b.source === "published" ? (publishedLabel ? publishedLabel(c.b) : "already published") : "in this upload",
      lines.join("\n"),
    ]);
  });
  if (conflicts.length === 0) s4.push(["", "No overlaps found. This timetable can be published.", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""]);
  const ws4 = tableSheet(["#", "Faculty", "Day", "Class A", "Time A", "Class B", "Time B", "Class B is", "Suggested changes"], s4,
    [5, 24, 12, 28, 16, 28, 16, 26, 90], { headBg: "9B2C3B", rowStyle: () => ({ bg: conflicts.length ? "FDF1F1" : "E6F2EA", boldCols: [1] }) });

  const s5 = workload.map(w => [w.name, w.external ? "No (outside)" : "Yes", w.teaching, w.other, w.overall, w.asst, w.theory, w.lab, w.drawing, ...w.perDay]);
  const ws5 = tableSheet(["Faculty", "In portal?", "Teaching workload", "Other duties", "Overall workload", "Of which assisting", "Theory", "Lab", "Drawing", ...DAY_SHORT], s5,
    [30, 13, ...Array.from({ length: 13 }, () => 12)], { numFrom: 1, headBg: GREEN, rowStyle: () => ({ boldCols: [0, 4] }) });

  [[SHEET3, ws3], [SHEET3B, ws3b], [SHEET4, ws4], [SHEET5, ws5]].forEach(([name, ws]) => {
    if (wb.SheetNames.includes(name)) { delete wb.Sheets[name]; wb.SheetNames = wb.SheetNames.filter(n => n !== name); }
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, name);
  });
  return wb;
}

// Written with the styled library so the colours survive.

  XLSX.writeFile(wb, fileName);
}

export function newReportWorkbook() {
  return XLSX.utils.book_new();
}
